sa: तमप्रतिहतं क्रुद्धं प्रविष्टं पुरुषर्षभम्। सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Seeing that foremost of men, Laksmana, exercised with wrath, as he entered in without let, Sugrīva was seized with sadness.

sa: इति ब्रुवन्तं राजानमनयन् द्वारदर्शिनः। कौसल्याया गृहं तत्र न्यवेश्यत विनीतवत्॥
en: When the king had spoken thus, the ushers taking him to Kausalyā's chamber, made his lie down in lowly plight.

sa: नह्यहं तमपश्यन्ती भर्तारं विबुधोपमम्॥ उत्सहे शत्रुवशगा प्राणान् धारयितुं चिरम्।
en: Not beholding my lord resembling a celestial, I cannot, come under the sway of my enemy, bear to live long.

sa: तां जहार सुसंहृष्टो रावणो मृत्युमात्मनः॥ उत्सङ्गेनैव भुजगी तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रां महाविषाम्।
en: Experiencing the height of delight, Rāvana ravished her, taking her on his lap like a sharp-toothed serpent of virulent poison.

sa: तं चापि समनुज्ञाप्य धर्मज्ञः सह सीतया। राघवः शोकसम्मूढो जननीमभ्यवादयत्॥
en: Then with the king's permission, the righteous Rāghava, stupefied with sorrow, in company with Sītā, paid respects to his mother.

sa: वनवासं हि संख्याय वासांस्याभरणानि च। भर्तारमनुगच्छन्त्यै सीतायै श्वशुरो ददौ॥
en: Counting the term of their stay in the woods, her father-in-law furnished Sītā following her lord with attires and ornaments.

sa: त्वमशोकस्य शाखाभिः पुष्पप्रियतरा प्रिये। आवृणोषि शरीरं ते मम शोकविवर्धनी॥
en: O my dear, you delights greatly in flowers. Covering your own Person with Asoka twigs you are increasing my grief.

sa: अयोध्यानिलयानां हि पुरुषाणां महायशाः। बभूव गुणसम्पन्नः पूर्णचन्द्र इव प्रियः॥
en: That illustrious one crowned with every perfection was dear to the inhabitants of Ayodhyā like to the full moon himself.

sa: अथ रेणुसमुद्भवस्तं समुत्थाप्य नराधिपम्। न्यवर्तत तदा देवी कौसल्या शोककर्शिता॥
en: Then raising the lord of men covered with dust, the noble Kausalyā pierced with grief, stopped (along with the monarch.)

sa: मन्त्री विजयमूलं हि राज्ञां भवति राघव। सुसंवृतो मन्त्रिधुरैरमात्यैः शास्त्रकोविदैः॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, counsel well kept by clever councillors versed in lore, is the root of victory with kings.

sa: तदा तु जृम्भितं शैवं धनुर्भीमपराक्रमम्॥ हुंकारेण महादेवः स्तम्भितोऽथ त्रिलोचनः।
en: Then on Vişņu uttering a roar, Siva's bow of dreadful prowess became flaccid. And thereupon the three-eyed Mahadeva became moveless.

sa: सुशुभश्चित्रकूटोऽसौ गिरिराजसमो गिरिः। यस्मिन् वसति काकुत्स्थः कुबेर इव नन्दने॥
en: This Citrakuța is fortunate, this hill like to the monarch of mountains, in which resides Kākutstha, like Kuvera in Nandana.

sa: द्विविधो जायते व्याधिः शारीरो मानसस्तथा। परस्परं तयोर्जन्म निर्द्वन्द्वं नोपलभ्यते॥
en: There are two sorts of diseases, viz., physical and mental. Each originates from the other. None of them exists independently.

sa: युधिष्ठिरोऽपि धर्मात्मा भ्रातृभिः सहितो रणे॥ हृष्टः पर्यचरद् राजन् दुर्योधनवधेप्सया।
en: The virtuous Yudhishthira, with his brothers in that battle, felt great joy and wandered Over the field for killing Duryodhana.

sa: आदिरेष हि भूतानां मध्यमन्तश्च भारत। विचेष्टते जगच्चेदं सर्वमस्यैव कर्मणा॥
en: He, is the beginning, the middle, and the end of all creatures! This universe acts and moves through his power.

sa: शल्यं सेनापतिं कृत्वा मद्रराजं महारथाः। प्रविभज्य बलं सर्वमनीकेषु व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Having made the king of the Madras their leader, the great car-warriors, of the Kauravas, made detachments of their soldiers.

sa: पताकाध्वजसंछन्नं पदातीनां महद् बलम्॥ निकृत्तं विबभौ रौद्रं घोररूपं भयावहम्।
en: Covered with banners and standards, that large army of foot-soldiers looked fierce and terrible and lay prostrate on the field.

sa: नातिदूरापयातं तु कृतबुद्धिं पलायने॥ दुर्योधनः स्वकं सैन्यमब्रवीद् भृशविक्षतम्। न तं देशं प्रपश्यामि पृथिव्यां पर्वतेषु च॥ यत्र यातान्न वा हन्युः पाण्डवाः किं सृतेन वः।
en: Addressing his own army which had not fled far but which, wounded with arrows, were bent upon flying, Then Duryodhana said these words: "I do not see a place on plain or mountain, where if you fly, the Pandavas will not pursue and kill you. What is the use of flight?

sa: हताश्वे नकुले यत्तु वृषसेनेन भारत। अपिबः शोणितं संख्ये दुःशासनशरीरजम्॥
en: When Vrishasena, however, had deprived Nakula of his horses, O Bharata, you drank in battle the blood from Dussasana's body.

sa: अक्रुध्यत रणे भीमस्तैस्तदा पर्यवस्थितैः॥ सोऽवतीर्य रथात् तूर्णं पदातिः समवस्थितः।
en: Encountered by those warriors, Bhima became furious. And quickly getting down from his car, he proceeded on foot against them.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा सिंहमायान्तं नागः सिंहभयार्दितः। ऋषि शरणमापेदे वेपमानो भयातुरः॥
en: Seeing the lion coming, the Rishi's elephant, from fear of life, began to tremble and sought refuge with the sage,

sa: अस्मिन् प्रतिभये कूपे निमग्नं नष्टचेतसम्। ततस्त्रितो महाराज भागांस्तेषां यथाविधि॥
en: The Rishi said to them-"Behold me, you denizens of heaven, fallen into this terrible pit almost deprived of my senses.

sa: अप्रियैः सह संयोगो विप्रयोगश्च सुप्रियैः। अर्थानों सुखं दुःखं विधानमनुवर्तते॥
en: The absence of what is pleasant, the presence of what is disagreeable, good and evil, happiness and misery, follow Destiny.

sa: द्रौपदी हतपुत्रेयं कृपणा हतबान्धवा। अस्मत्प्रियहिते युक्ता भूयः पीडयतीव माम्॥
en: This Draupadi, again, who is eve busy with pleasing us, bereaved of son and kinsmen, is causing me great pain.

sa: तां समाश्वासयामास पृथा पृथुललोचना॥ उत्थाप्य याज्ञसेनी तु रुदतीं शोककर्शिताम्।
en: Raising the grief-stricken princess of Panchala who was weeping thus, Pritha began to solace that lady having of large eyes.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते बाणे भूमौ ज्वलिततेजसि। प्रविवेश महारण्यं मृगो राजाप्यथाद्रवत्॥
en: That effulgent arrow accordingly fell on the ground. The deer entered a large forest, but the king still pursued it.

sa: एवं सर्वास्ववस्थासु सान्त्वपूर्वं समाचरेत्। प्रियो भवति भूतानां धर्मज्ञो वीतभीनृपः॥
en: The king should thus, under all circumstances, behave with conciliation. A fearless and virtuous king, is loved by all creatures.

sa: सोऽहमद्य यथाकामं क्षत्रधर्ममुपास्य तम्। गन्तास्मि पदवीं राज्ञः पितुश्चापि महात्मनः॥
en: Following Kshatriya duties, therefore, without hesitation, I shall to-day walk in the steps of my great father and the king.

sa: ततो देवो मुनिं दृष्ट्वा हर्षाविष्टमतीव ह। सुराणां हितकामार्थं महादेवोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Then Mahadeva, seeing the Rishi filled with great joy and desirous of doing good to the celestials addressed him, saying.

sa: विदूतानि च सर्वाणि शिविराणि समन्ततः। इतस्तत: पलायन्ते हतनाथा हतौजसः॥
en: All those that were in the Kuru camp have fled. Alas, dispirited and helpless they are flying on all sides.

sa: द्रौपदीं चापि दुःखार्ती पञ्चपुत्रैर्विनाकृताम्॥ शोचामि पृथिवीं हीनां पञ्चभिः पर्वतैरिव।
en: I grieve also for Draupadi who is deprived of her five sons like the Earth shorn of her five mountains.

sa: ततो हलधरः श्रीमान् ब्राह्मणैः परिवारितः। जगाम् तत्र राजेन्द्र रुषमुस्तनुमत्यजत्॥
en: Surrounded by Brahmanas, then the beautiful Baladeva went to that spot, O king, where Rushangu had, formerly, renounced his body.

sa: जैगीषव्यं मुनिवरं व ददर्शाथ देवलः। आहारकाले मतिमान् परिवाड् जनमेजय॥
en: Thus, O king, they both lived long together. On one occasion, Devala lost sight of Jaigishavya, that foremost of ascetics.

sa: अनेकशतसाहस्र बले दुर्योधनस्य ह। नान्यो महारथो राजन् जीवमानो व्यदृश्यत॥ द्रोणपुत्रादृते वीरात् तथैव कृतवर्मणः। कृपाच गौतमाद् राजन् पार्थिवाच तवात्मजात्॥
en: In Duryodhana's army then, O monarch, which had many hundred thousands of warriors, not one single car-warrior was alive, save the heroic son of Drona and Kritavarman and Kripa the son of Gotama, the lord of earth viz., your son.

sa: नित्यपुष्पफलाश्चैव पादपा निरुपद्रवाः। सर्वा द्रोणदुघा गावो रामे राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: The trees always bore flowers and fruits and suffered form no accidents. Every cow gave milk filling a drona-full milk.

sa: एवं राजंस्तवाचक्षे स्वयं पन्थानमुत्तमम्। न युद्धादधिकं किंचित् क्षत्रियस्येह विद्यते॥
en: I tell you. O king, that these is no superior way to heaven for a Kshatriya to one thought battle.

sa: एवं हि क्षत्रबन्धूनां मार्गमाहुः प्रधानतः। नास्य कृत्यतमं किंचिदन्यद् दस्युनिबर्हणात्॥
en: This is the conduct of a wretched Kshatriya. There is no greater duty for him than the suppression of robbers.

sa: यः सहस्रं सहस्राणां कन्या हेमविभूषिताः। ईजानो वितते यज्ञे दक्षिणामत्यकालयत्॥
en: King Bhagiratha, in one of the sacrifices he celebrated, gave away a million of maidens bedecked with ornaments of gold.

sa: सात्यकेश्चैव यो वेगो भीमसेनस्य चोभयोः। दारयेच गिरीन् सर्वाशोषयेचैव सागरान्॥
en: The vigour of those two, viz., Satyaki and Bhimasena, would rend all the mountains or dry up all the oceans!

sa: भग्नचक्रान् रथान् केचिदहरंस्तुरगा रणे॥ रथाधु केचिदादाय दिशो दश विबभ्रमुः।
en: Some horses were seen to drag cars with broken wheels, while some ran on all sides, carrying the broken cars.

sa: ततो भीमो रुषाविष्ट पुत्रस्य तव मारिष। सारथि चतुरश्वाश्वाशरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Excited with ire Bhima then, O sire, killed with his arrows the driver and the four horses of your son.

sa: ततस्तां पतितां दृष्ट्वा संरम्भी सत्यविक्रमः। बाहुभ्यां परिजग्राह समुत्पत्य वृकोदरः॥
en: Seeing her prostrate on the Earth, the wrathful Vrikodara, advancing hastily, raised her up and clasped her with his arms.

sa: जह्रोरजस्तु तनयो बलाकाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः। कुशिको नाम धर्मज्ञस्तस्य पुत्रो महीपते।॥
en: Jahnu had a son named Rajas. Rajas had a son named Balakashva. King Balakashva had a pious son named Kushika.

sa: कदाचिद्धि ततो राजन् भ्रातरवेकतद्वितौ॥ यज्ञार्थं चक्रतुश्चिन्तां तथा वित्तार्थमेव च।
en: Once upon a time, the two brothers Etaka and Dvita thought of celebrating a sacrifice and became anxious for wealth.

sa: उच्चावचकरा दाप्या महाराज्ञा युधिष्ठिर॥ यथा यथा न सीदेरंस्तथा कुर्यान्महीपतिः।
en: The king, O Yudhishthira, may levy high taxes, but he should never levy such taxes as would oppress his people.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं रुक्मपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः॥ त्रिभिः शरैरसम्भ्रान्तो ललाटे वै समार्पयत्।
en: Fearlessly then the son of Karna struck the bowless Nakula at the forehead with three gold-winged arrows whetted on stone.

sa: तेषां मध्ये महाबाहुः श्रीमान् केशवपूर्वजः॥ व्यविशत् परमप्रीतः पूज्यमानो महारथैः।
en: Thus adored by those great car-warriors, the mighty-armed elder brother of Keshava, of great beauty, took his seat amongst them.

sa: भग्नशृङ्गा वृषा यद्वद् भग्नदंष्ट्रा इवोरगाः। प्रत्यपायाम सायाह्ने निर्जिताः सव्यसचिना॥
en: Discomfited by Savyasachin that evening they took to their heels like bulls with broken horns or serpents with wounded fangs.

sa: तुष्टेर्न किञ्चित् परमं सा सम्यक् प्रतितिष्ठति। विनीतक्रोधहर्षस्य सततं सिद्धिरुत्तमा॥
en: There is nothing superior to contentment. To the Yogin who has controlled anger and joy, contentment is the greatest success.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धो महाराज सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥ तोमरं प्रेषयामास स्वर्णदण्डं महाधनम्।
en: Enraged, O king, the highly powerful Salyaki then discharge at Shalya a golden lance set with many jewels and gems.

sa: सजयित्वा रथान् किचिद् यथा मुख्यं विशाम्पते॥ आप्लुत्य पाण्डवानीकं पुनयुद्धमरोचयन्।
en: Some, arranging their cars in order, O king, of superiors and inferiors, proceeded against the Pandavas once more for battle.

sa: क्षत्रबीजं यथा दग्धं रामेण यदुपुङ्गव। कथं भूयः समुत्पत्तिः क्षत्रस्यामितविक्रम॥
en: When the very Kshatriya seed was burnt by Rama, O foremost of the Yadus, how was the Kshatriya order revived?

sa: एवं ये भूतिमिच्छेयुः पृथिव्यां मानवाः क्वचित्। कुर्दू राजानमेवाग्रे प्रजानुग्रहकारणात्॥
en: 'Thus, O Yudhishthira, men on Earth seeking prosperity should first elect and crown a king for the protection of all.

sa: समन्तपञ्चकद्वारात् ततो निष्क्रम्य माधवः। पप्रच्छर्षिगणान् रामः कुरुक्षेत्रस्य यत् फलम्॥
en: Then having come out of Samantapanchaka, Baladeva enquired at of the Rishis about the results of the battle at Kurukshetra.

sa: तमेषा हि समागम्य भार्या भर्तारमन्तिके। विराटदुहिता कृष्ण पाणिना परिमार्जति॥
en: Approaching her husband, that young wife, viz., the daughter of Virata, is gently rubbing him, O Krishna, with her hand.

sa: गच्छन्नेव महाबाहुः स वै यादवनन्दनः। युधिष्ठिराय प्रोवाच जामदग्न्यस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: While proceeding, the powerful Keshava, that delighter of all the Yadavas, spoke to Yudhishthira about the prowess of Jamadagni's son.

sa: बाह्वन्तरादाधिरथेर्विमुक्तान् बाणान् महाहीनिव दाप्यमानान्। व्यध्वंसयनर्जुनबाहुमुक्ताः शराः समासाद्य दिशः शितायाः॥
en: Meeting in the sky the shining and snakelike arrows discharged by Karna, these keen ones, shot by Arjuna, destroyed them.

sa: आपद्विनाशभूयिष्ठं गतैः कार्यं हि जीवितम्॥ समन्तात् संशयात् सैषा तस्मादापदुपस्थिता।
en: Preventing numberless dangers by hundreds of means, one should always save his life. Danger, now, besets me on every side.

sa: अज्ञातवासचर्या च नानावेषसमावृतैः। अन्ये च बहवः केशात् त्वशक्तैरिव सर्वदा॥
en: With his brothers he lived in concealment and disguise. They also suffered various miseries as if they were quite helpless.

sa: तस्याज्ञां शिरसा योधाः परिगृह्य विशाम्पते। विवर्णवदना राजन् न्यविशन्त महारथाः॥
en: Obeying his orders, O king, the great carwarriors, bending low their heads, left the battle-field depressed and with pale countenances.

sa: तुष्टुवुस्ते कुमारं तु सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः। जगुश्च देवगन्धर्वा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः॥
en: All the gods, with Vasava at their head, lauded Kumara. The celestials and the Gandharvas sang and the Apsaras danced.

sa: कश्यप उवाच आत्मा रुद्रो हृदयो मानवानां स्वं स्वं देहं परदेहं न हन्ति। वातोत्पातैः सदृशं रुद्रमार्ह र्देवैर्जीमूतैः सदृशं रूपमस्य॥
en: Kashyapa said Rudra exists in the hearts of men. He destroys the bodies themselves in which he lives as also the bodies of others. Rudra is like visitations of the sky and his form is like that of the wind-god.

sa: यथैतान्यकृथाः पार्थ महाकर्माणि वै पुरा॥ तथा द्रौणिममित्रघ्न विनिहत्य सुखी भव। तस्या बहुविधं दुःखान्निशम्य परिदेवितम्॥ नामर्षयत कौन्तेयो भीमसेनो महाबलः।
en: Like those great deeds, O Partha, performed by you forinerly, kill now, O slayer of foes, the son of Drona and be happy.'-Hearing these and other piteous cries of the princess, Kunti's son the powerful Bhima, could not bear them.

sa: एवमन्योन्यमायत्ता योधा जघ्नुर्महाहवे। पितृन भ्रातृन् वयस्यांश्च पुत्रानापि तथा परे॥
en: Thus the warriors fought with one another in that great battle and killed fathers and brothers and friends and sons.

sa: तस्याज्ञां शिरसा योधाः परिगृह्य विशाम्पते। विवर्णवदना राजन् न्यविशन्त महारथाः॥
en: Obeying his orders, O king, the great carwarriors, bending low their heads, left the battle-field depressed and with pale countenances.

sa: सा तु तत्त्वा तपो घोरं दुश्चरं स्त्रीजनेन ह। गता स्वर्ग महाभागा देवब्राह्मणपूजिता॥ श्रुत्वा ऋषीणां वचनमाश्रमं तं जगाम ह।
en: Having practised the hardest of penances such as the incapable of being performed by women, the blessed lady at last went to heaven, adored by the gods and Brahmanas. Having heard these words of the Rishis, Baladeva entered that hermitage.

sa: ततो भागीरथीतीरे कदाचिनिर्जने वने। धात्रीद्वितीयो बालः स क्रीडार्थं पर्यधावत॥
en: One day, on the bank of the Bhagirathi, the boy accompanied by his nurse, ran here and there in play.

sa: सर्वलोकागमं कृत्वा मृदुत्वं गन्तुमेव च। विश्वासाद् विनयं कुर्याद् विश्वसेच्चाप्युपायतः॥
en: Pleasing all people of opposition taking them in trust with humble, king should search other means to regain previous ones.

sa: निघ्नन्तो निशितैःशस्त्रैर्धातॄन् पुत्रान् सखीनपि। योधाः परिपतन्ति स्म यथामिषकृते खगाः॥
en: Assailing brothers and sons and even fathers with keen weapons, the combatants fought like birds, for a piece of meat.

sa: रथं हेममयं शुभं शैव्यसुग्रीवयोजितम्। सह सात्यकिना कृष्णः समास्थायान्वयात् कुरून्॥३९।
en: Upon his own shining car of gold to which were yoked Shivya and Sugriva. Krishna, with Satyaki, followed the Kurus.

sa: अनेन तु ममाद्यापि व्यसनेनोपतापिता॥ बुद्धिश्चिन्तयते किंचित् स्वं श्रेयो नावबुद्ध्यते।
en: This great calamity has burnt my good sense. Plunged in thought I fail to see what is for our good.

sa: पात्यमानाः परैर्ये तु हीयमाना निरायुधाः। ह्रीनिषेवा महात्मानः परानभिमुखा रणे॥ छिद्यमानाः शितैः शस्त्रैः क्षत्रधर्मपरायणाः। गतास्ते ब्रह्मसदनं न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा॥
en: Those great warriors who, observing the duties of Kshatriyas and regarding flight from battle to be disgraceful, have fallen, wounded with keen weapons, while advancing unarmed against fighting foes, have all assumed bring forms and reached the regions of Brahman!

sa: तेषु राजसहस्रेषु तावकेषु महात्मसु। एको दुर्योधनो राजन्नदृश्यत भृशं क्षतः॥
en: Amongst those thousands and thousands of great kings belonging to your party, only Duryodhana now, O king, exceedingly mangled, survives.

sa: क्षेममद्य करिष्यामि धर्मराजस्य माधव। हत्वैतद् दुर्बलं सैन्यं धार्तरष्ट्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Slaying this weak army in the very presence of Dhritarashtra's son, I shall today do what is for Yudhishthira's good."

sa: स विकारं शरीरस्य दृष्ट्वा नृपतिरात्मनः। प्रीतोऽस्मीत्यब्रवीत् कर्णं वैरमुत्सृज्य दूरतः॥
en: Feeling himself very much pained, and giving up desire of hostility, the king of Magadha addressed Karma, saying,-I am pleased.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते वीरे तावका भयमोहिताः॥ अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे भीमसेनं युयुत्सवः।
en: Upon the death of that hero, your soldiers, though terror-stricken, rushed in that battle against Bhimasena for fighting with him.

sa: सात्यकिं भीमसेनं च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥ एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विध्वा युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्।
en: Piercing Satyaki and Bhimasena and the twin sons of Madri by Pandu, each with five arrows, he assailed Yudhishthira greatly.

sa: ततः किलकिलाशब्दः प्रादुरासीद् विशाम्पते। पाण्डवानां प्रहृष्टानां पञ्चालानां च सर्वशः॥
en: Then a tumult arose, O king, from among the Pandavas and the Panchalas all of whom were filled with joy.

sa: स चिन्तयामास मुनिः किं नु मे सुकृतं भवेत्। कथं वृथा न मृत्युः स्यादिति पार्थिवसत्तम॥
en: The sage began to reflect, aside,-What is best for me to do now?-Indeed, O best of kings, he then thought oniy of the means by which he could avoid immediate death.

sa: राजोवाच आशायाः किं कृशत्वं च किं चेह भुवि दुर्लभम्। ब्रवीतु भगवानेतत् त्वं हि धर्मार्थदर्शिवान्॥
en: What is the extent of the faintness of Hope? What on Earth is highly difficult to acquire? Tell me this, O holy one, for you are master of virtue and profit.

sa: तैस्त्रिभिः शोणितादिग्धैर्निः श्वसद्भिर्महारथैः॥ शुशुभे स वृतो राजा वेदी त्रिभिरिवाग्निभिः। ते तं शयानं सम्प्रेक्ष्य राजानमतथोचितम्॥
en: Encircled by those three great car-warriors who were covered with blood and who sighed heavily, the Kuru king looked like a sacrificial altar surrounded by the tiree heroes weeping in sorrow.

sa: शूद्र एतान् परिचरेत् त्रीन् वर्णाननुपूर्वशः॥ संचयांश्च न कुर्वीत जातु शूद्रः कथंचन। पापीयान् हि धनं लब्ध्वा वशे कुर्याद् गरीयसः॥ राज्ञा वा समनुज्ञातः कामं कुर्वीत धार्मिकः।
en: He should serve the three other classes according to their order of seniority. A Shudra should never amass riches, lest by them, he makes the members of the three superior orders obedient to him. By this he would incur sin. With the king's permission, however, a Shudra, for religious observances, may acquire wealth.

sa: किरातारूपी भगवान् सुधृत्या त्वया महात्मा परितोषितोऽभूत्॥ तां त्वां पुनर्वीर धृतिं गृहीत्वा सहानुबन्धं जहि सूतपुत्रम्।
en: You have even satisfied the great god Mahadeva (in battle) when he was disguised as a hunter; recovering the same patience, O hero, kill this son of Suta and his followers.

sa: अनीतिजं यस्य विधानजं सुखं हठप्रणीतं विधिवत्प्रदृश्यते। न विद्यते तस्य गतिर्महीपर्ते न विद्यते राज्यसुखं ह्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: That king, who neglects the happiness which policy yields and seeks for that which chance may bring, never succeeds in enjoying the happiness of sovereignty or in acquiring blissful regions hereafter.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच क्व समुत्थाः कथंशीला ऋत्विजः स्युः पितामह। कथंविधाश्च राजेन्द्र तद् ब्रूहि वदतां वर॥
en: Yudhishthira said How O grandfather, should persons, employed as priests in our sacrifices, act? What sort of persons should they be, O king? Tell me all this, O foremost of orators.

sa: पूजन्युवाच न कृतस्य तु कर्तुश्च सख्यं संधीयते पुनः हृदयं तत्र जानाति कर्तुश्चैव कृतस्य च॥
en: Pujani said No friendship can again be formed between a person who has injured and him who has inflicted an injury in return. The hearts cannot forget what has taken place.

sa: यस्मै वह्निर्वरं प्रादात् ततो ववे वरान् गयः। ददतो योऽक्षयं वित्तं धर्मे श्रद्धा च वर्धताम्॥
en: (Pleased with his devotion) Agni offered him boons. The boons prayed for by Gaya were,-May not wealth suffer extinction even if I give ceaselessly. Let my respect virtue exist for ever.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनश्च भीमश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥ सात्यकिश्च नरव्याघ्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः। धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च पञ्चाला: सह सोमकैः॥ युधिष्ठिरं परीप्सन्तः समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्।
en: Then Arjuna, Bhima and the two sons of Madri by Pandu and that foremost of men, Satyaki and the (five) sons of Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna and Sikhandin and the Panchalas and the Somakas, desirous of rescuing Yudhishthira, encircled him on all sides.

sa: भीष्म उवाच रक्षणं सर्वभूतानामिति क्षात्रं परं मतम्। तद् यथा रक्षणं कुर्यात् तथा शृणु महीपते॥
en: Bhishma said The protection of all creatures is considered the highest duty of the Kshatriya. Listen now to me, o king, as to how the duty of protection to be performed.

sa: न च सोऽति पुमान् कश्चित् पाण्डवानां बलार्णवे। यो गजो रथो वापि यः स्याद् बाणैरविक्षतः॥
en: There was then not a man amongst the Pandavas in that great battle or a horse or an elephant or a car, who or which was not struck with Duryodhana's arrows.

sa: नष्टे धने वा दारे वा पुत्रे पितरि वा मृते। अहो दुःखमिति ध्यायन् दुःखस्यापचितिं चरेत्॥
en: At the loss of one's riches or the death of one's wife or son or father, one cries out saying-Alas what grief!-and the continued thought of that sorrow always increases it.

sa: न पृथिव्या सकलया न सुवर्णस्य राशिभिः। न गवाश्वेन सर्वेण ते त्याज्या य इमे हताः॥
en: They who have been killed should not have been killed for the sake of even the whole Earth of mountains of gold, or all the horses and kine in this world.

sa: तान् समाश्वास्य योधास्तु मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्॥ व्यूह्य व्यूहं महाराज सर्वतोभद्रमृद्धिमत्। प्रत्युद्ययौ रणे पार्थान् मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्॥ विधुन्वन् कार्मुकं चित्रं भारघ्नं वेगवत्तरम्।
en: Assuring him the valiant king of the Madras, having formed, O king, a grand array, proceeded against the Parthas in battle. And the brave king of the Madras possessed, shaking his beautiful and strong bow capable of shooting arrows with great force.

sa: उत्तर उवाच परमोऽनुग्रहो मेऽद्य यतस्तर्को न मे वृथा। न हीदृशाः क्लीबरूपा भवन्ति तु नरोत्तम॥
en: Uttara said you have done me a great favour today for I now see that my suspicion was not altogether unfounded. Persons like you, O foremost of men, cannot be eunuchs.

sa: इह क्षेत्रे क्रियते पार्थ कार्य न वै किञ्चित् क्रियते प्रेत्य कार्यम्। कृतं त्वया पारलौक्यं च कर्म पुण्यं महत् सद्भिरतिप्रशस्तम्॥
en: During this life deeds are done, O son of Pritha and after death, no act whatever is done. And virtuous deeds that are valuable in the next world and so be-lauded by the great and the honest, have been done by you.

sa: यक्ष उवाच किंस्वित् सुप्तं न निमिषति किंस्विज्जातं न चोपति। कस्यस्विद्धदयं नास्ति किंस्विद् वेगेन वर्धते॥
en: The Yaksha said: What is that which does not close the eyes while sleeping? What is it that has no heart? And what is it that swells with its own force?

sa: प्रियाप्रिये सुखदुःखे च राजन् निन्दाप्रशंसे च भजन्त एव। परस्त्वेनं गर्हयतेऽपराधे प्रशंसते साधुवृत्तं तमेव॥ तृष्णाक्षयान्ते
en: O king, man is subject to good and bad, happiness and misery, praise and censure. He wins praise when he does any good act and blame when he commits any wrong.

sa: अथ चेन्मन्यसे श्रेयो न मे भेदो भवेदिति। प्रशाम्य भरतश्रेष्ठ मा च युद्धे मनः कृथाः॥
en: And if you think that a rupture with them is not beneficial to you, be peaceful, O foremost among the race of Bharata and do not set your heart on battle.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच पिता मे ध्रियते देव माता चान्ये च बान्धवाः। न तेषु ध्रियमाणेषु विधिलोपो भवेदयम्॥
en: Kunti said: O god, my father is alive and so also my mother and friends. And since they are (still) living, this violation of duty (on my part) is not allowable.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच स हत्वा रावणं क्षुद्रं राक्षसेन्द्रं सुरद्विषम्। बभूव हृष्टः ससुहृद् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह॥
en: Markandeya said : Having killed the mean-minded Ravana, the lord of the Rakshasas and the enemy of the gods, great indeed was the joy of Rama and the son of Sumitra.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच प्रीतोऽस्मि पुरुषव्याघ्र न भयं विद्यते तव। सर्वान् नुदामि ते शत्रून् रणे रणविशारद॥
en: Arjuna said I am pleased with you, O best of men, you have no fear. I shall disperse all your enemies in battle, O you conversant with all forms of warfare.

sa: वृद्धो ह्यहं वै परिहारकामः सर्वान् मत्स्यांस्तरसा पालयस्व। नैवंविधाः क्लीपरूपा भवन्ति कथंचनेति प्रतिभाति मे मनः॥
en: I am decrepit, and desirous of cast-off my burden. Rule you cheerfully the whole of the Matsya territory, I cannot believe that such persons may even be of the neuter sex.”

sa: प्रियं कार्यं हि मे तस्य यस्यास्मि वचने स्थितः। ब्रूहि गालव यास्यामि शृणु चाप्यपरां दिशम्॥
en: My duty is to do what you wish, for I am ready to carry out your orders; speaks, O Galava and I shall go; listen to me about another cardinal point.

sa: वस्तुं त्वयीच्छामि विशां वरिष्ठ तान् राजसिंहान् न हि वेद्मि पार्थान्। न शक्यते जीवितुमप्यकर्मणा न च त्वदन्यो मम रोचते नृपः॥
en: O foremost of men, I do no know where the sons, of Pritha the foremost among men, are; I want to live with you. I can not keep myself without service. I do not like to serve any other king except you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तेषां तथा वृत्तिं नगरे वसतामिव। दुर्योधनो महाराज तेषु पापमरोचयत्॥ तथा तैनिकृतिप्रज्ञैः कर्णदुःशासनादिभिः। नानोपायैरघं तेषु चिन्तयत्सु दुरात्मसु॥ अभ्यागच्छत् स धर्मात्मा तपस्वी सुमहायशाः। शिष्यायुतसमोपेतो दुर्वासा नाम कामतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing that they (the Pandavas) are living in the forest as in a city, the great king Duryodhana with Karna, Dushashana and others longed to do them harm. When those wicked men were concerting various evil designs, the virtuous and the celebrated ascetic Durvasa, wandering about at will, came to the city of the Kurus with ten thousand disciples.

sa: यत्र भीष्मश्च द्रोणश्च कृपः कर्णो विविंशतिः। अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सोमदत्तोऽथ बाह्निकः॥ सैन्धवश्च कलिङ्गश्च काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः। युधिष्ठिरो भीमसेनः सव्यसाची यमौ तथा॥ सात्यकिश्च महातेजा युयुत्सुश्च महारथः। को नु तान् विपरीतात्मा युद्ध्येत भरतर्षभ॥
en: Against the side taken up by Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Kripa, Vivingshati, Ashvathama, Vikarna, Somadatta, Bahlika the king of the Sindhus and the lord of the Kalingas, the chief of the Kambojas, Sudakshina, Yudhishthira, Bhimasena, Savyasachi and the twins and Satyaki of great energy and the great carwarrior Yuyutsu, who is there of such misdirected energy to fight, O you the best among the Bharatas.

sa: कुतो मे भोजने श्रद्धा सुखश्रद्धा कुतश्च मे। श्रद्धा मे जीवितस्यापि छिन्ना किं जीवितेन मे॥
en: How can I get satisfaction from eating? How can I get satisfaction from happiness? My happiness derived from life itself is broken up. What is the use of my living on?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्य मात्रा च स्वयं पित्रा च भानुना। चचाल नैव कर्णसय मतिः सत्यधृतेस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Being thus spoken to by his mother, and by his father Bhanu himself, the resolve, formed by Karna, who was ever devoted to truth, did not undergo any change.

sa: गतिरात्मवतां सन्तः सन्त एवं सतां गतिः। असतां च गतिः सन्तो न त्वसन्तः सतां गतिः॥
en: The righteous are their own refuge and that of other righteous men. The righteous, too are the refuge of the unrighteous; and the unrighteous are never the refuge of the righteous.

sa: यक्ष उवाच किंस्वित् प्रवसतो मित्रं किंस्विन्मित्रं गृहे सतः। आतुरस्य च किं मित्रं किंस्विन्मित्रं मरिष्यतः॥
en: The Yaksha asked Who is the friend of an exile? Who is the friend of a householder? Who is the friend of a sick person and who of a dying one?

sa: यस्य कृत्यं न जानन्ति मन्त्रं वा मन्त्रितं परे। कृतमेवास्य जानन्ति स वै पण्डित उच्यते॥
en: He is said to be a wise man whose proposed acts, line of action agreed on are not known to other and known only after they have been put into execution.

sa: सा तान् दृष्ट्वा वीडमानेव बाला सूर्यं देवी वचनं प्राह भीता। गच्छ त्वं वै गोपते स्वं विमानं कन्याभावाद् दुःख एवापचारः॥
en: Beholding them, the maiden was covered with shame. And being alarmed, the damsel spoke these words to Surya “O lord of rays, go to your own place. This outrage on your part is greatly distressing to me as I am a maiden.

sa: य एतत् प्राप्य मुच्येत न तं पश्यामि पूरुषम्। हिमवांश्च समुद्रश्च वज्री वा बलभित् स्वयम्॥
en: I do not see the man who can free himself after once getting within them. The Himavat, the ocean and the wielder of the thunder-bolt and the grinder of Bala himself.:

sa: यक्ष उवाच तस्य तेऽर्थाच्च कामाच्च आनृशंस्यं परं मतम्। तस्मात् ते भ्रातरः सर्वे जीवन्तु भरतर्षभ।१३३॥
en: The Yaksha said: O best of the Bharatas, since abstention from cruelty is, in your opinion, superior to both profit and desire, let, therefore all your brothers be restored to life.

sa: कर्ण उवाच नाहं जीवति गाङ्गेये राजन् योत्स्ये कथंचन। हते भीष्मे तु योत्स्यामि सह गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: Karria said So long as the son of Ganga is alive I shall never fight, O king; when Bhishma is slain, I shall fight with him who wields the Gandiva bow.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच एवमुक्ते महाराज द्रोणेनामिततेजसा। व्याजहार ततो वाक्यं विदुरः सत्यसङ्गरः। पितुर्वदनमन्वीक्ष्य परिवृत्य च धर्मवित्॥
en: Vasudeva said Words like these having been spoken by Drona of immeasurable energy, Vidura, ever devoted to truth, then said these words turning towards his father's uncle and looking at him.

sa: शङ्के श्रुतोऽयं वृत्तान्तो रामेण हरियूथपाः॥ अयं च हर्षादाख्याति तेन जानामि हेतुना। तत् क्षमं नेह नः स्थातुं कृते कार्ये परंतपाः॥
en: O you leaders of the monkey hosts, I fear, Rāma has heard all about this. Dadhimukha relates everything joyfully and hence I infer this. And our work finished, O slayer of foes, it dose not behove us to remain here (any longer).

sa: ततोऽश्मनगरं नाम कालकेयैरधिष्ठितम्। गत्वा तु कालकेयांश्च हत्वा तत्र बलोत्कटान्॥ शूर्पणख्याश्च भर्तारमसिना प्राच्छिनत्तदा। श्यालं च बलवन्तं च विद्युज्जिह्व बलोत्कटम्॥ जिह्वया संलिहन्तं च राक्षसं समरे तदा।
en: And then going to the city named Asma ruled by the Kālakāyas, (Rāvana) slew the Kālakāyas endowed with terrific strength; and then with his sword cut off his brother-in-law,' the husband of Śūrpanakhā, he mighty Vidyutjibha possessed of terrific strength; as the Rākşasa in the encounter was licking (the limbs of Ravana's followers).

sa: सुखं स्वपिति निश्चिन्तः कामोपहतचेतनः॥ नव सप्त दशाष्टौ च मासान्स्वपिति राक्षसः। मन्त्रं कृत्वा प्रसुप्तोऽयमितस्तु नवमेऽहनि॥
en: And deprived of his senses through lust, he sleep secure. And the Rākşasa sometimes sleep nine, seven, ten, or eight months away. Of measureless might he has slept for nine months.

sa: विनिष्पतद्भिः शतशश्चित्रैः पुष्पावतंसकैः। समूलपुष्परचितैरशोकैः शोकनाशनैः॥ पुष्पभारातिभारैश्च स्पृशद्भिरिव मेदिनीम्। कर्णिकारैः कुसुमितैः किंशुकैश्च सुपुष्पितैः॥ स देशः प्रभया तेषां प्रदीप्त इव सर्वतः।
en: He saw there the earth touched by Asoka trees, the removers of grief, having flowers growing from the roots and lowered down with their weight. And the entire quarter was as if ablaze with the beauty of the flowery Karrikaras and Kingsukas.

sa: व्यसनेषु न कृच्छ्रेषु न युद्धेषु स्वयंवरे। न क्रतौ नो विवाहे वा दर्शनं दूष्यते स्त्रियाः॥
en: There is no sin consequent uponi seeing women in danger, difficulty, war, Svayamvara* sacrifice and marriage. *It is a form of marriage in which the bride selects a bridegroom foe herself.

sa: श्रुत्वा भ्रातृवधं कोपादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। यवीयान् केन मे भ्राता हतः क्व च निपातितः॥ एतदाख्यातुमिच्छामि भवद्भिर्वानरोत्तमाः।
en: Hearing of the destruction of his brother, he in wrath, said-'By whom and where has my younger brother been killed? I wish to hear this from you, the foremost of monkeys.

sa: ते केवलं संददृशुः शिताग्रान् बाणारणे वानरवाहिनीषु। मायाविगूढं च सुरेन्द्रशत्रु न चात्र तं राक्षससम्पपश्यन्।५३ ।।
en: In the conflict they could only see sharp pointed shafts among the monkey-ranks, but that foe of the celestial chief-the Raksasas, hidden by virtue of illusion, they could not discover there.

sa: ततः प्रजग्मुः प्रशमं मरुद्गणा दिशः प्रसेदुर्विमलं नभोऽभवत्। मही चकम्पे न च मारुतो ववौ स्थिरप्रभश्चाप्यभवद्दिवाकरः॥
en: Thereupon the celestials attained their peace, the quarters were delighted, the atmosphere was clear, calm air began to prevail all over the earth, and the Sun appeared in its full rays.

sa: नमोऽस्तु वाचस्पतये सवज्रिणे स्वयम्भुवे चैव हुताशनाय। अनेन चोक्तं यदिदं ममाग्रतो वनौकसा तच्च तथास्तु नान्यथा॥
en: Be glory to Vācaspati, Indra, the self existent Brahmā, the lord of fire and may they so grant that the creature who has spoken before me, be real and not imaginary.

sa: क एष सुमहाकायो बलेन महता वृतः। आगच्छति महावेगः किंरूपबलपौरुषः॥ आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो वीर्यवन्तं निशाचरम्।
en: Who is this huge-bodied one that armed with impetuosity, advance to the encounter And what is his power and prowess like O Mighty-armed one, tell me this concerning this powerful nightranger.

sa: इदं ब्रूयाश्च मे नाथं शूरं रामं पुनः पुनः। जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज ॥ ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं सत्येनाहं ब्रवीमि ते।
en: This also shall you say again and again to that hero— my lord, 'O son of Dasaratha, I shall keep on this life for another month; and this I swear to you by truth that I will not live beyond this month.

sa: बहूनि च करोति स्म दृश्यन्ते न त्वसौ ततः। प्रतिगृह्य ततो राम महदस्त्रं दशाननः। जघान मूर्ध्नि धनदं व्याविद्ध्य महतीं गदाम्॥
en: Thus he wore full many forms and he was not visible in his native shape. And then, O Rāma, seizing a mighty weapon the Ten-necked one, whirling the same, brought that redoubtable mace down on the head of the bestower of riches.

sa: हा स्वप्नः सत्यमेवेदं त्वं रामेण कथं हतः॥ त्वं मृत्योरपि मृत्युः स्याः कथं मृत्युवशं गतः।
en: That you wouldst be slain by Rāma was like a dream, but it has proved true! You were like death to Death himself, why have you been possessed by him then?

sa: न खल्वयं नाभिभवेदुपेक्षितः पराक्रमो ह्यस्य रणे विवर्धते। प्रमापणं ह्यस्य ममाद्य रोचते न वर्धमानोऽग्निरुपेक्षितुं क्षमः॥
en: If I disregard him, he shall certainly vanquish me, for his prowess in battle increase (fast). Therefore I must even slay him: it is not proper to suffer an increasing fire.

sa: तां स्वसारं समुत्थाप्य रावणः परिसान्त्वयन्॥ अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे वक्तुकामासि मां द्रुतम्। सा बाष्पपरिरुद्धाक्षी रक्ताक्षी वाक्यमब्रीत्॥
en: Having raised up his sister and consoled her Rāvana said, “Tell me speedily, O good sister, what you wish to say.” Thereat that she-demon, having blood-red eyes, closed with tears, said.

sa: इक्ष्वाकुकुलवंशस्तु स्तुतो मम पुरस्कृतः। श्रुत्वा तु गदिमां वाचं राजर्पिगणभूषिताम्॥ प्रत्यभाषत मां देवी बाष्पैः पिहितलोचना।
en: I began by extolling the Ikşvāku race. Hearing the words that I uttered, embellished with descriptions of the virtues of Rajarşis, that exalted lady replied with her eyes covered with tears.

sa: ततो वैश्रवणो राजा यमश्च पितृभिः सह। सहस्राक्षश्च देवेशो वरुणश्च जलेश्वरः॥ षडर्धनयनः श्रीमान्महादेवो वृषध्वजः। कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः॥ एते सर्वे समागम्य विमानैः सूर्यसंनिभैः। आगम्य नगरी लङ्कामभिजग्मुश्च राघवम्॥
en: Thereupon the king Vaiśravaņa, Yama with his progenitors, the thousand-eyed lord of the celestials, Varuna, the lord of water, the threeeyed graceful Mahădeva-the rider of bull, Brahmă the creator of the world and the foremost of those conversant with the knowledge of Brahmā-all these arriving at the city of Lankă in their cars bright as the rays of the sun, approached Rāghava.

sa: त्वां द्रष्टमुपयातोऽहं समाश्रित्य पराक्रमम्। नाहमस्मि तथा देवि यथा मामवगच्छसि। विशङ्का त्यज्यतामेषा श्रद्धत्स्व वदतो मम॥
en: I have come here to see you I am not he (Ravana) for whom you are taking me, O worshipful dame. Do you renounce your suspicion and rely on my words.

sa: तथा च सर्वास्तिमिरेण वै दिशो मेधैर्वृता न प्रदृश्येत किंचित्। अथापोवाह्याभ्रसंघान समस्तान् वायव्यास्त्रेणापततः स कर्णात्॥ ततोऽप्यस्त्रं दयितं देवराज्ञाः प्रादुश्चक्रे वज्रमतिप्रभावम्। गाण्डीवं ज्यां विशिखांश्चानुमन्त्र्य धनंजयः शत्रुभिरप्रधृष्यः॥
en: All the sides being covered by those clouds became very dark and nothing could be seen, but Arjuna with the vary weapons dispersed those clouds. Then the invisible Dhananjaya, inspiring the Gandiva, its string and the shafts with mantras, invoked a favourite weapon of the king of Heaven and powerful like his thunder.

sa: स तूत्तमौजा निशितैः पृषत्कैविव्याध खङ्गेन च भास्वरेण। पाणि हयांश्चैव कृपस्य हत्वा शिखण्डिवाहं स ततोऽध्यरोहत्॥
en: Uttamaujas, in the interval, trucking home, with his keen shafts and the sharp edge of his steed, the steed and the side-guards of Kripa, quickly leapt into the chariot of Shikhandin.

sa: विजयं च धनुः श्रेष्ठं विधुन्वानो महारथः॥ पार्षतस्य धनुश्छित्त्वा शरांश्चाविषोपमान्। ताडयामास संक्रुद्धः पार्षतं नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Boiling with rage the great car-warrior Karna shook the best of his bows, Vijaya. Then cutting off his bow and arrows like unto deadly serpents he struck Dhristadyumna with nine shafts.

sa: तमब्रवीत्ततो यन्ता कचित् क्षेमं तु पार्षत॥ ईद्दशं व्यसनं युद्धे न ते दृष्टं मया क्वचित्।
en: Thereupon his charioteer uttered these words to him-'O son of Prishata, it is well with you, perhaps. Such a great calamity was never witnessed by me in the battle, overtaking you?

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच इदानीं पार्थ जानामि न वृद्धाः सेवितास्त्वया। काले न पुरुषव्याघ्र संरम्भं यद् भवानगात्॥
en: “Now I understand, O Partha, that you have never attended upon the old, since you, O mightiest of men, have been overcome with anger at a time quite out of season.

sa: संजय उवाच पञ्चालानां ततो द्रोणोऽप्यकरोत् कदनं महत्। यथा क्रुद्धो रणे शक्रो दानवानां क्षयं पुरा॥
en: Sanjaya said Then Drona effected a fierce carnage in the ranks of the Panchala troops, like the enraged Shakra causing a great slaughter amongst the Danava troops in days gone by.

sa: स तेन विद्धोऽतिभृशं तरस्वी महाहवे वृषसेनेन राजन्॥ क्रुद्धेन धावन् समरे जिघांसुः कर्णात्मजं पाण्डुसुतो नृवीरः।
en: O monarch, being greatly distressed by Vrishasena in that encounter, Pandu's son Nakula, the best of men and of great energy then rushed on for the purpose of killing Karna's son.

sa: अदृश्यौ च शिरोघेस्तो निघ्नन्तावितरेतरम्। कर्ण पार्थोऽस्मि तिष्ठ त्वं कर्णोऽहं तिष्ठ फाल्गुन।।७६ इत्येवं तर्जयन्तौ तौ वाक्शल्यैस्तुदतां तदा। युध्येतां समरे वीरौ चित्रं लघु च सुष्ठु च॥
en: Each made invisible by the other's arrowy downpour, they went on striking each other; they roared at each other and wounded each other with their sharp arrows respectively saying, I am Partha wait or I am Karna, wait, O Phalguna. Indeed those two heroes fought with each wonderfully, displaying great skill and agility.

sa: देवा ऊचुः बिभर्तुं भवतोऽर्धं तु न शक्ष्यामो महेश्वर। सर्वेषां नो बलार्धेन त्वमेव जहि शात्रवान्॥
en: The celestials said O Maheshvara, we are not capable of bearing half of your energy. Do you slaughter the antagonists with one-half of the entire strength, possessed by all of us.

sa: द्रौणिपाण्डवयोरेवं वर्तमाने महारणे। वर्धमाने च राजेन्द्र द्रोणपुत्रे महाबले॥ हीयमाने च कौन्तेये कृष्णे रोषः समाविशत्।
en: In that deadly conflict between Drouni and the Pandava, O king of kings Krishna, seeing the powerful son of Drona get the better of the son of Kunti, became highly infuriated.

sa: संजय उवाच द्रौणि पराजित्य ततोऽग्रधन्वा कृत्वा महद् दुष्करं शूरकर्म। आलोकयामास ततः स्वसैन्यं धनंजयः शत्रुभिरप्रधृष्यः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having vanquished Drona's son and performed a highly difficult and heroic task, Dhananjaya, ever irrepressible to his enemies, with a bow ready in his hands, eyed his own army.

sa: व्यदीपयंस्ते ध्वजिनीं प्रदीप्तां तथा बलं पाण्डवेयाभिगुप्तम्। तेन प्रदीप्तेन तथा प्रदीप्तं बलं तवासीद् बलवद् बलेन॥
en: By virtue of (the lustre of) those lamps that army became fiercely blazed up like a blazing fire made fiercely illuminated by the rays of the sun, the maker of day.

sa: मृगसङ्घान यथा क्रुद्धः सिंहो द्रावयते वने॥ पञ्चालानां रयश्रेष्ठान् द्रावयशात्रवांस्तथा। कर्णस्तु समरे योधास्त्रासयन् सुमहायशाः॥ कालयामास तत् सैन्यं यथा पशुगणान् वृकः।
en: As in a wild the herds of deer are scared away before an angry lion or other animals seeing an wolf, so, in that battle, the foremost car-warriors of the Panchalas and other great car-warriors of the Pandavas were driven before Karna.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नरथं त्यक्त्वा भीताः सम्प्राद्रवन् दिशः। तान् प्रभग्नांस्ततो द्रौणिः पृष्ठतो विकिरशरान्॥ अभ्यवर्तत वेगेन कालयन् पाण्डुवाहिनीम्। ते वध्यमानाः समरे द्रोणपुत्रेण पार्थिवाः॥ द्रोणपुत्रभयाद् राजन् दिश: सर्वाश्च भेजिरे॥
en: Filled with fear, abandoned the car of Dhristadyumna and fled in all directions. Then Drona's son discharging his arrows with great fury, pursued those routed troops spreading a terrible carnage in their ranks. Thus carnaged by the son of Drona those Kshatriya fled away in all directions from fear of that illustrious warrior.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच न त्वेतदद्भुतं मन्ये यत् ते महदिदं मनः। अस्मासु च परा भक्तिस्तव गौतमिनन्दन॥
en: Duryodhana said I do not deem it (i.e., what you say) wonderful because you have a large mind and (because), O son of Goutama's daughter, you are devotedly attached to us.

sa: तदेवं समरे पार्थ वर्तमाने महाभये। भीमसेनं समासाद्य त्वां च पाण्डव कौरवाः॥ सवाजिरथमातङ्गा मृत्युलोकमितो गताः।
en: Therefore, O Partha, in the course of this terrible battle the Kauravas, along with their steeds, cars and elephants, have fallen victims of Death no sooner they encountered Bhimasena and yourself.

sa: पास्यन्ति रुधिरं तेषां गृध्रा गोमायवस्तथा। उत्तमाङ्गानि कर्षन्तो यैः कृष्टासि सभातले॥ तेषां द्रक्ष्यसि पाञ्चाली गात्राणि पृथिवीतले। क्रव्यादैः कृष्यमाणानि भक्ष्यमाणानि चासकृत्॥
en: They themselves will be mocked; and their blood will be drunk by the jackals and vultures. ( daughter of Panchala, you shall see the bodies of those that dragged you by the hair at once dragged and devoured by the carnivorous animals.

sa: स भवान् कृतबुद्धीनां प्रधान इति मे मतिः। कुलेन च विशिष्टोऽसि वयसा च श्रुतेन च॥
en: I am of opinion that you are the chief among those who have cultured understanding, you come of a respectable family and you are aged both in years and in learning.

sa: स्त्रियो वृद्धा भारतानां जनन्यो महानस्यो दासभार्याश्च सूत। वध्वः पुत्रा भागिनेया भगिन्यो दौहित्रा वा कच्चिदप्यव्यलीकाः॥
en: Are the aged ladies the mothers of the sons of Bharata and the slave-wives of the great one, O Suta and daughter-in law, sons, sister' sons and daughter' sons in peace?

sa: ततो जनक्षयं कृत्वा पाण्डवानां महात्ययम्॥ दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्यैव चान्योन्यं समेत्योचुर्महारथाः। पर्यष्वजत् ततो द्रौणिस्ताभ्यां सम्प्रतिनन्दितः॥ इदं हर्षात् तु सुमहदाददे वाक्यमुत्तमम्। पञ्चाला निहताः सर्वे द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः॥ सोमका मत्स्यशेषाश्च सर्वे विनिहता मया।
en: Having caused that great destruction of the Pandava forces, those three great car-warriors, viz., Ashvatthaman and Kripa and Kritavarman, meeting together, said, — 'Good luck,'—His two companions congratulated Ashvatthaman, and embraced him. Joyfully the latter said:-'All the Panchalas, as also all the sons of Draupadi, have been killed. All the Somakas and that remnant of the Matsyas, have been killed by me.

sa: पुष्टिषुतिस्तथा कीर्तिः सिद्धिबुद्धिरुमा तथा। त्वमेव वाणी स्वाहा त्वं तवायत्तमिदं जगत्॥ त्वमेव सर्वभूतेषु वससीह चतुर्विधा।
en: Thou art Pushti and Dyuti, Kiriti and Siddhi and Uma! Thou art Speech and thou art Svaha! This entire universe depends on thee. Thou dwellest in all creatures, in four forms."

sa: सौतिरुवाच जानार्दने न मे मोहो नापि मां भयमाविशत्। अतिभारं तु ते मन्ये शाल्वं केशवनन्दन॥
en: The Charioteer said: O son of Janardana, I am not bewildered. Fear has not taken possession of me. But ( son of Keshava, I think it is difficult to defeat Shalva.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तादृशा निहता यत्र कृत्वास्माकं जनक्षयम्॥ प्रागेव सुमहत् कर्म द्रौणिरेतन्महारथः। नाकरोदीदृशं कस्मान्मत्पुत्रविजये धृतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said “Why is it that great car-warriors, viz., the son of Drona, did not perform such an act before, although he had tried his best for conferring victory upon Duryodhana?

sa: जन्मकर्ततपोयोगास्तयोस्तव च पुष्कलाः। ताभ्यां लिङ्गेऽर्चितो देवस्त्वयार्चायां युगे युगे॥ सर्वरूपं भवं ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गे योऽर्चयति प्रभुम्।
en: Thus adored by you, the god became gratified on you in your previous life; and he then accorded to you, O learned one, excellent boons that you cherished in your heart.

sa: यदि ते सोऽनुजः कृष्णः प्रविष्टोऽनुमते मम। अनीकं न तु शक्यं मे प्रवेष्टुमिह वै त्वया॥
en: Without, in the first instance defeating myself, O mighty one, who is now your foe. It was with my permission that your younger brother, with Krishna, has penetrated into this array.

sa: त्वं हि देवेश सर्वस्य जगतः परमा गतिः। कोऽन्यः प्रसादो हि भवेद् यन्नः कृच्छ्रात् समुद्धरेत्।।५३
en: You are the Lord of all the gods, and the supreme refuge of the universe. Who else is there whom we may worship so that he may save us from distress.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आहारान् कीदृशान् कृत्वा कानि जित्वा च भारत। योगी बलमवाप्नोति तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said You should tell me, O grandfather, what the kinds of diet are by taking which, and what the things are by conquering which, the Yogin, O Bharata, gains Yoga-power.

sa: एवं स्तुतः स भगवान् पुरुषः सर्वतोमुखः॥ जहौ निद्रामथ तदा वेदकार्यार्थमुद्यतः। ऐश्वर्येण प्रयोगेण द्वितीयां तनुमास्थितः॥
en: Thus landed by Brahman, the illustrious Purusha, with face turned towards every side, then renounced his sleep, resolved to recover the Vedas. Applying his Yoga-power, he put on a second form.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। इक्ष्वाकोः सूर्यपुत्रस्य तद् वृत्तं ब्राह्मणस्य च॥ कालस्य मृत्योश्च तथा यद् वृत्तं तन्निबोध मे। यथा स तेषां संवादो यस्मिन् स्थानेऽपि चाभवत्॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding this subject that I am describing, is cited the old story of what too place between Surya's son Ikshvaku and a certain Brahmana, and Tiine and Mrityu. Listen to me as to what happened, and what was the conversation that took place between them and the place where it happened.

sa: स तु धैर्येण महता निगृह्णन् हृच्छयं मुनिः। न शशाक नियन्तुं तद् व्यास: प्रविसृतं मनः॥ भावित्वाच्चैव भावस्य घृताच्या वपुषा हृतः।
en: Inviting all his patience, the ascetic tried to suppress that desire. With all his efforts, however, Vyasa could not control his agitated mind. On account of the inevitability of what was to take place the Rishi's heart was drawn by Ghritachi's beauty.

sa: श्रीरुवाच एष मे निहितः पादो योऽयमग्नौ प्रतिष्ठितः। चतुर्थं शक्र पादं मे तस्मात् सुनिहितं कुरु॥
en: Shree said 'Here I give up my third quarter which is to be placed in Fire. Do you, O Shakra, after this, ! assign a proper place for my last quarter!'

sa: यत् तु निश्रेयसं सम्यक् तच्चैवासंशयात्मकम्॥ अनुग्रहं च मित्राणाममित्राणां च निग्रहम्। संग्रहं च त्रिवर्गस्य श्रेय आहुर्मनीषिणः॥ निवृत्तिः कर्मणः पापात् सततं पुण्यशीलता। सद्भिश्च समुदाचारः श्रेय एतदसंशयम्॥
en: That which is truly and, without any doubt, wholesome, viz., good offices to friends, and suppression of enemies, and the acquisition of be supreme the three-fold objects of life, has been described by the wise to excellence. Abstention, from sinful deeds, righteous disposition, good conduct towards the good and pious,-these, forsooth, constitute excellence.

sa: विश्वामित्र उवाच न पातकं नावमतमृषिः सन् कर्तुमर्हति। समौ च श्वमृगौ मन्ये तस्माद् भोक्ष्ये श्वजाघनीम्।।७५।
en: Vishvamitra said A man who is a Rishi cannot commit a sin. In the present case, deer and dog, I think, are the same. I shall, therefore, eat this dog's haunch.

sa: एवं धर्म पालयिष्यस्यथो त्वं न चात्मानं मज्जयिष्यस्यधर्मे। तस्मात् कामं रोचयाभ्यागतं त्वं संयोज्याथो संहरस्वेह जन्तून।३६॥
en: By doing this you will only observe righteousness instead of committing sin. Do you, therefore, mind the work in hand, and addressing Desire and Anger begin to kill all living creatures.

sa: हेतूनां साधनं चैव शृणु सर्वमशेषतः घ्राणं जिह्वा च चक्षुश्च त्वक् च श्रोत्रं च पञ्चमम्। मनो बुद्धिश्च सप्तैते विज्ञेया गुणहेतवः॥ गन्धो रसच रूपं च शब्दः स्पर्शश्च पञ्चमः। मन्तव्यमथ बोद्धव्यं सप्तैते कर्महेतवः॥ घ्राता भक्षयिता द्रष्टा वक्ता श्रोता च पञ्चमः। मन्ता बोद्धा च सप्तैते विज्ञेयाः कर्तृहेतवः॥ स्वगुणं भक्षयन्त्येते गुणवन्तः शुभाशुभम्।
en: Hear fully of causes. The noise, the tongue, the eye, the skin, the ear for the fifth, the mind and the understanding, these seven should be understood as the causes of qualities. Smell, taste, colour, sound, touch, numbering the fifth, the objects of the mind, and the objects of the understanding, these are the seven causes of action. He who smells, he who eats, he who sees, he who speaks, he who hears, numbering the lifth, he who thinks, and he who understands, these seven should be known as the causes of action. Endued with qualitics, these enjoy their own qualities, agrecable or disagrecable.

sa: इत्युक्तास्ते चक्रुराशु प्रतीता दिवौकसः शक्रवाक्यान्नरेन्द्र। ततो वाक्यं प्राह राजानमिन्द्रः प्रीतो राजन् पूज्यमानो मरुत्तम्॥ एष त्वयाहमिह राजन् समेत्य ये चाप्यन्ये तव पूर्वे नरेन्द्र। सर्वाश्चान्या देवता: प्रीयमाणा हविस्तुभ्यं प्रतिगृह्णन्तु राजन्॥
en: o king, thus directed, the renowned denizens of heaven quickly carried out the directions of Shakra. And then, O king, Indra well-pleased and worshipped, thus said to king Marutta, O prince, by associating with you at this sacrifice, your ancestors who have gone before you, as well as the other celestials have been highly pleased and accepted the oblations offered by you.

sa: इति पृष्टो द्विजैस्तैः स प्रहसन् नकुलोऽब्रवीत्। नैषा मृषा मया वाणी प्रोक्ता दर्पण वा द्विजाः॥
en: Thus addressed by those twice-born persons, the mungoose, siniling, answered them as follows. “You twice-born ones, the words I have uttered are not false. Neither have I spoken them from pride.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच नागलोके यदि ब्रह्मन् न शक्ये कुण्डले मया। प्राप्तुं प्राणान् विमोक्ष्यामि पश्यतस्तु द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Utanka said If, O Brahmana, the ear-rings be not recovered by me from the regions of the Nagas, I shall renounce my life-breaths before your eyes, O foremost of twice-born persons.

sa: तस्य चाक्ष्णो महत् तेजो येनायं मथितो गिरिः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं च मे देवि प्रकृतिस्थः पुनः कृतः॥
en: The great energy of that eye crushed and consumed this mountain. For pleasing you, however, O goddess, I once more restored Himavat to his pristine condition for making good the injury.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच यज्ञस्य विधिमग्र्यं वै फलं चापि नराधिपा गदतः शृणु मे राजन् यथावदिह भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Do you listen to me, O king, as I describe to you duly, O Bharata, the excellent ordinances about sacrifice and the fruits also, O king, that sacrifice yields.

sa: भयं ते सुमहत् कस्मात् कुत्र किं वा कृतं त्वया। येन त्वमिह सम्प्राप्तो विसंज्ञो भ्रान्तचेतनः॥
en: Whence have you taken such great fright? What and where have you done it in consequence of which you have lost your senses in fear and are more dead than alive?

sa: यत् ते ते न करिष्यन्ति कृतं ते न भविष्यति। यज्ञान् साधय साधुभ्यः स्वाद्वन्नान् दक्षिणावतः॥
en: If such Brahmanas do not accept your gifts, no merit will become yours. Do you celebrate sacrifices with profuse Dakshina, and make gifts of good and agreeable food to the righteous.

sa: एतां बुद्धिं समाश्रित्य ममत्वं वर्जितं मया। शृणु बुद्धिं च यां ज्ञात्वा सर्वत्र विषयो मम॥
en: Depending upon this notion. I got rid of the idea of mineness. Hear now what that notion is depending upon which I arrived at the conclusion that I have dominion everywhere.

sa: स चन्द्रमाः स चेशानः स सूर्यो वरुणश्च सः। स काल: सोऽन्तको मृत्युः स यमो रात्र्यहानि च।। मासार्धमासा ऋतवः संध्ये संवत्सरश्च सः। स धाता स विधाता च विश्वकर्मा स सर्ववित्॥
en: He is the Moon; he is Ishana; he is the Sun; he is Varuna; he is Time; he is the Destroyer; he is death; he is the day and the Night; he is the fortnight; he is the seasons; he is the two twilghts; he is the year. He is Dhatri; and he is Vidhatri; and he is Vishwakarinan; and he knows all things.

sa: श्वा ततो जायते पूढः कर्मणा तेन पार्थिव। भूत्वा श्वा पञ्च वर्षाणि ततो जायति मानवः॥
en: On account of his sin, that foolish man has next to take birth as a dog, O king. Living as a dog for five years, he then regains his human form.

sa: धारयन्ति प्रजाश्चैव पयसा हविषा तथा। एतासां तनयाश्चापि कृषियोगमुपासते॥ जनयन्ति च धान्यानि बीजानि विविधानि च।
en: With their milk and the Havi produced therefrom, they sustain all creatures. Their male children are engaged in helping the cultivation and thereby produce various kinds of paddy and other seeds.

sa: तं समासाद्य मेधावी स तदा द्विजसत्तमः। चरणौ धर्मकामोऽस्य तपस्वी सुसमाहितः। प्रतिपेदे यथान्यायं दृष्ट्वा तन्महदद्भुतम्॥
en: Himself possessed of penances, Kashyapa, moved by the wish of acquiring merit, fell, with a rapt heart, at the feet of the sage when he had seen all those wonderful attributes.

sa: नारद उवाच राजन्नङ्गिरसः पुत्रः संवर्तो नाम धार्मिकः। चङ्क्रमीति दिशः सर्वा दिग्वासा मोहयन्प्रजाः।।१८। तं गच्छ यदि याज्यं त्वां न वाञ्छति बृहस्पतिः। प्रसन्नस्त्वां महातेजाः संवर्तो याजयिष्यति॥
en: Narada said The virtuous son of Angirasa, Samvarla by name, is travelling over all the earth in a nude state to the amazement all creatures; do you, O prince, go to him, if Brihaspati does not wish to officiate at your sacrifice, the powerful Samvarta, if pleased with you, will perform your sacrifice.

sa: यो मे दृष्टिपथं गच्छेत् स मे वश्यो भवेदिति। इत्यनेन वरं देवो याचितो गच्छता दिवम्॥
en: Coming to the celestial region, the boon that Nahusha prayed for, was that, whoever would come within the range of his vision would, deprived of all energy, come within his control.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच पुनर्गत्वा पार्थिवं त्वं समेत्य वाक्यं मदीयं प्रापय स्वार्थयुक्तम्। स्त्वत्तो वज्रं सम्प्रहर्तास्मि तस्मै॥
en: Do you return to that king and meeting him, tell him these words of mine, full of meaning and if he obey them not, I shall strike him with my thunderbolt.

sa: समुत्सृज्य धनुः पार्थो विधिवद् भगिनीं तदा॥ प्राह किं करवाणीति सा च तं प्रत्युवाच ह। एष ते भरतश्रेष्ठ स्वस्रीयस्यात्मजः शिशुः॥ अभिवादयते पार्थ तं पश्य पुरुषर्षभ।
en: Leaving off his bow, Partha duly received his sister and enquired of her as to what he could do for her. The queen replied to him, saying, O chief of the Bharatas, this child is the son of your sister's son. He salutes you, O Partha. Look at him, O foremost of men.

sa: सूत उवाच न सम्भ्रमो मे वार्ष्णेय विद्यते सत्यविक्रम। यद्यपि स्यात् तव क्रुद्धो जामदग्न्योऽग्रतः स्थितः॥
en: The Charioteer said O scion of the Vrishni race, fear I have none, O you of prowess incapable of being withstood! If you had before you the enraged son of Yamadagni.

sa: स प्राप्तकालमाज्ञाय चकार च ततः स्वनम्। सदृशं राघवस्येव हा सीते लक्ष्मणेति च ॥ तेन मर्मणि निर्विद्धं शरेणानुपमेन हि। मृगरूपं तु तत् त्यक्त्वा राक्षसं रूपमास्थितः॥
en: And pierced to the marrow by that peerless shaft, Marica, renouncing his deer form, resumed his Rākşasa lineaments; and giving up his life attaining a huge person, considering the time had come (for availing himself of the advice tendered by Rāvana), began to cry with the voice of Rāghava, Ah Sita! Ah Laksmana!

sa: स्मरसि ननु यदा परैर्हतः स च धृतराष्ट्रसुतोऽपि मोक्षितः। दिनकरसदृशैः शरोत्तमैर्युधा कुरुषु बहून् विनिहत्य तानरीन्॥
en: Do you remember, O Karna, the occasion when killing the large nuinber of enemies with this arrows effulgent like the sun Arjuna liberated the son of Dhritarashtra himself among the Kurus?

sa: यक्ष उवाच मा तात साहसं कार्मिम पूर्वपरिग्रहः। प्रश्नानुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेय ततः पिब हरस्व च॥
en: The Yaksha said: O child, do not attempt it. It has already been in my possession, (first) answer my questions and then drink water and carry it away (for your brother).

sa: ततः प्रहस्य समरे नकुलस्य महारथः। अश्वांश्च चतुरो रांजश्चतुर्भिः सायकोत्तमैः॥ प्रेषयामास समरे यमस्य सदनं प्रति। हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णमवप्लुत्य महारथः॥
en: Thereafter in that combat, that mighty carwarriors the Madra king, O king, with four excellent arrows dispatched smilingly Nakula's four steeds to the monsoon of Death. Then that mighty car-warrior Nakula jumping down from his car of which the horses were slain.

sa: न योनि पि संस्कारो न श्रुतं न च संततिः। कारणानि द्विजत्वस्य वृत्तमेव तु कारणम्॥
en: Neither birth, nor the purificatory rites, nor learning, nor offspring, can be considered as grounds for conferring upon one the dignity of a twiceborn person Indeed, conduct is the only ground.

sa: स्निग्धा यस्य बहुव्यामा दीर्घलांगूलमाश्रिताः। ताम्राः पीताः श्वेताः प्रकीर्णा घोरकर्मणः॥ प्रगृहीताः प्रकाशन्ते सूर्यस्येव मरीचयः। पृथिव्यां चानुकृष्यन्ते हरो नामैष वानरः॥ यं पृष्ठतोऽनुगच्छन्ति शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। वृक्षानुद्यम्य सहसा लङ्कारोहणतत्पराः॥ यूथपा हरिराजस्य किंकराः समुपस्थिताः।
en: That one of dreadful deeds the long hairs on whose long tail, coppery, and yellow, and black, and white, thrown up, look like the rays of the Sun, and are trailing over the ground, is the monkey, named Hara; whom follow hundreds and thousands (of monkeys) desperately upraising trees, intent upon (scaling) Lankā-the leaders of the monkey-king and his servants present (in this conflict.)

sa: स मामुवाच तिग्मांशुवृथाऽऽह्वानं न मे क्षमम्। धक्ष्यामि त्वां च विप्रं च येन दत्तो वरस्तव॥
en: He replied to me, saying, 'I cannot bear the idea of coming to you fruitlessly, I shall consume you as also that Brahmana who gave you the Mantra as a boon.

sa: स तं रथं हेमविभूषिताङ्गं साश्वं ससूतं सहसा विमृद्या उत्क्षिप्य हस्तेन नदन् महाद्विपो विपोथयामास वसुन्धरातले॥
en: That huge elephant, meanwhile, suddenly crushing that gold-decked car with its horses and driver, raised it up in the air with his trunk and then dashed it down on the Earth.

sa: न तत्राविश्य शोचन्ति न प्रहष्यन्ति च द्विजाः। न च बिभ्यति केषांचित् तेभ्यो बिभ्यति केचन॥
en: Twice-born persons. entering into it, at once get over both joy and sorrow. They (then) never stand in fear of any creature, nor does any creature stand in fear of them.

sa: ततः स त्वरमाणस्तु पटे निपतिते तदा। ग्रहीष्यामीति तं राजा नलमाह महामनाः॥ निगृहणेष्व महाबुद्धे हयानेतान् महाजवान्। वार्ष्णेयो यावदेनं मे पटमानयतामिह॥
en: When the garinent had thus dropped down, then the lofty-minded king instantly expressed to Nala his desire to recover it. O you of profound intelligence, do you restrain these horses of great swiftness, until Varshneya bring me back my upper garment here.

sa: श्रुत्वा मे देवदेवस्य वाक्यं परममद्भुतम्। प्रीतिर्हि महती जाता तवागमनसंभवा॥ त्रयाणामपि लोकानां कार्यार्थ मम संभवः। भद्रं तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि यत एवाहमागतः॥
en: I have been greatly pleased and happy for your coming here O my son, I descended on earth to bring about the well-being of the three worlds. May good betide you. I shall now repair to from where I have come here.

sa: प्रतिजाने च ते वीर मा भूवं वीरलोकभाक् । राज्यं च तव रक्षेयमहं वेलेव सागरम्॥
en: I do promise to you, Oh great hero, that I shall protect your kingdom like to shore protecting the sea, or else I shall not attain to the region of heroes.

sa: कल्याणवृत्तः सततं हि राजा वैचित्रवीर्यस्य सुतो ममासीत्। तस्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमहं त्यजामि प्रियान भोगान् दुस्त्यजं जीवितं च॥
en: O king, the son of Chitravirya's son always does me good. For the accomplishment of his object I will give up this dear life which it is very difficult to renounce.

sa: शक्र उवाच अमर्त्यत्वं मत्समत्वं च राजन् श्रियं कृत्स्नां महतीं चैव सिद्धिम्। संप्राप्तोऽद्य स्वर्गसुखानि च त्वं त्यज श्वानं नात्र नृशंसमस्ति॥
en: Shakra said You have acquired today Immortality and a status equal to mine, O king, prosperity extending in all directions and high success, and all the felicities of heaven. Do you cast off this dog. In this there will be no cruelty.

sa: अथ वैदूर्यवर्णेषु शाद्वलेषु महाबलः। धीरः सलिलकल्पेषु विचचार यथासुखम्॥ द्विजान् वित्रासयन् धीमानुरसा पादपान् हरन्। मृगांश्च सुबहून् निघ्नन् प्रवृद्ध इव केसरी॥
en: Then he, wise and mighty monkey walked over the earth, green with grass, with irresistible steps. At that time, he brushed aside all animals like a lion and crushed down many trees, and thereby scared away the feathered denizens of the forest.

sa: चन्दनागुरुनिर्यासान् सरलं पद्मकं तथा। देवदारूणि चाहृत्य क्षेपयन्ति तथापरे॥ गन्धानुच्चावचांश्चान्यांस्तत्र गत्वाथ भूमिपम्। तत्र संवेशयामासुश्चितामध्ये तमृत्विजः॥
en: Others procuring sandal, aguru and other sarala, padmaka and devadari, cast it (on the earth). And drawing near the king there, Rtvigs laid various other fragrant substances on the funeral pile.

sa: कच्चित्ते निर्जिता विघ्नाः कच्चिते वर्धते तपः। कच्चित्ते नियतः कोप आहारश्च तपोधने॥ कच्चित्ते नियमाः प्राप्ताः कच्चित्ते मनसः सुखम्। कच्चित्ते गुरुशुश्रूषा सफला चारुभाषिणि ॥ ततो रामः
en: O you of sweet accents, have you got all hindrances to asceticism removed? Is your asceticism growing stronger every day? O you having asceticism for your wealth, have you restricted your anger and fare? Have you observed the commandments and attained to mental felicity? Have your attendance upon your spiritual guide born fruits?

sa: नैवंरूपा मया नारी दृष्टपूर्वा महीतले। रूपमग्यं च लोकेषु सौकुमार्यं वयश्च ते॥ इह वासश्च कान्तारे चित्तमुन्माथयन्ति मे। सा प्रतिकाम भद्रं ते न त्वं वस्तुमिहार्हसि ॥
en: I had never seen before on this earth a damsel so beautiful as you. This your beauty the best on earth, your youth, your grace and your abode in the forest do agitate my mind. So it is well for you to come (with me); it does not behove you to remain here.

sa: रामस्तस्य तु विज्ञाय सीतासक्तां प्रियां कथाम्। गृध्रराजं परिष्वज्य परित्यज्य महद् धनुः॥ निपपातावशो भूमौ रुरोद सहलक्ष्मणः। द्विगुणीकृततापा” रामो धीरतरोऽपि सन्॥
en: Hearing from him pleasant words relating to Sītā, Rāma, leaving aside, instantly, his mighty bow, embraced him, and rolling on earth having lost self-control through grief, began to lament with Lakşmaņa. Though highly composed by nature, he was overwhelmed with doubled grief.

sa: प्रसाद्यमानश्च मया सोऽब्रवीन्मां महायशाः। यदा दाशरथी रामस्त्वां वधिष्यति संयुगे॥ तदा प्रकृतिमापन्नो भवान् स्वर्गं गमिष्यति।
en: Being propitiated by me, that greatly famous one said, 'When Rāma the son of Dasaratha, shall slay you in encounter, you, attaining your natural condition, shall repair to the celestial regions.'

sa: पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद् वाक्यं यथापूर्वं निशम्य ते। तथा द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञा वर्धयन्तो नृपोत्तमम्॥ अनुज्ञातास्ततः सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्।
en: Then hearing those words of that best king again, as heard before, conversant with their duty, having blessed the monarch, taking permission of the king, they returned to their respective quarters.

sa: तया स राजर्षिसुतोऽभिकामया समेयिवानुत्तमराजकन्यया। अतीव रामः शुशुभे मुदान्वितो विभुःश्रिया विष्णुरिवामरेश्वरः॥ इति श्रीरामायणे बालकाण्डं समाप्तम्
en: And experiencing delight, Rama, receiving the Rājarși's daughter, exercising her own will the excellent princess-looked graceful, even like the lord Vişņu the chief of celestials on being joined with Śrī. BĀLAKĀŅDA

sa: निमित्तानि च घोराणि दृश्यन्तेऽद्य बहूनि च। इत्येवं चिन्तयन् रामः श्रुत्वा गोमायुनिःस्वनम् ॥ निवर्तमानस्त्वरितो जगामाश्रममात्मवान्।
en: And many and dreadful are the omens I see (around me). Thus reflecting as he heard the howlings of the jackals, the self-possessed Rāma with hasty steps returned to the asylum.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं सुहृदं भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह। शृणु त्वं यनिमित्तं मे दैन्यमेतदुपागतम्॥ स्वप्ने पितरमद्राक्षं मलिनं मुक्तमूर्धजम्। पतन्तमद्रिशिखरात् कलुषे गोमये हृदे॥
en: Thus asked by his friend, Bharata answered, “Listen why this depression has overtaken me. In a dream I beheld my father, pale, with his hair loosely flowing about, plunging from the summit of a mountain into a dirty pool filled with cowdung.”

sa: अथ तत्र सहासीनास्तदा दशरथं नृपम्॥ प्राच्योदीच्या प्रतीच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च भूमिपाः। म्लेच्छाश्चार्याश्च ये चान्ये वनशैलान्तवासिनः॥ उपासांचक्रिरे सर्वे तं देवा वासवं यथा।
en: The kings of the North, and the South and the East and the West, together with the Mlecchas and the Arya princes, with those inhabiting mountains and forests were then paying homage to him (Daśaratha) even as the celestials do to Vasava.

sa: धिक् ते शौर्यं च सत्त्वं च यत्वया कथितं तदा। कुलाक्रोशकरं लोके धिक् ते चारित्रमीदृशम्॥
en: Fie on your heroism and your truth, of which you did speak at that time; and fie also on this character of yours, calculated to sully your line in this world.

sa: ततः सज्यं धनुः कृत्वा रामः सुनिशिताशरान्। सुशीघ्रमभिसंधाय राक्षसं निजघान ह॥ धनुषा ज्यागुणवता सप्त बाणान् मुमोच ह। रुक्मपुङ्खान् महावेगान् सुपर्णानिलतुल्यगान्॥
en: Then stringing his bow, Rāma, speedily aiming at the Rākşasa, pierced him with sharpened shafts; and (then) from his bow-string let go seven shafts, having their feathered parts plaited with good, furnished with great velocity, and coursing like Suparna or the wind.

sa: उभे संध्ये शयानस्य यत् पापं परिकल्प्यते। तच्च पापं भवेत् तस्य यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥ यदग्निदायके पापं यत् पापं गुरुतल्पगे। मित्रद्रोहे च यत् पापं तत् पापं प्रतिपद्यताम्॥
en: May he that had approved of the exile into the woods of that noble one, come by the demerit that is his who sleeps during both the twilight's! May he reap the sin that is reaped by an incendiary or him that Leith with his preceptor's wife; or him that wrongs his friend!

sa: स राजपुत्रः प्रियया विहीनः शोकेन मोहेन च पीड्यमानः। विषादयन् भ्रातरमार्तरूपो भूयो विषादं प्रविवेश तीव्रम्॥
en: That son of a king, stricken as he was with grief consequent upon separation from his dear one, was again overwhelmed with a terrible grief after causing sorrow to his brother,

sa: सीतया सह काकुत्स्थस्तस्मिन् घोरमृगायुते। ददर्श गिरिशृङ्गाभं पुरुषादं महास्वनम् ॥ गभीराक्षं महावक्त्रं विकटं विकटोदरम्। बीभत्सं विषमं दीर्घ विकृतं घोरदर्शनम्॥ वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं वसाट्टै रुधिरोक्षितम्। त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां व्यादितास्यमिदान्तकम्॥ त्रीन् सिंहाश्चतुरो व्याघ्रान् द्वौ वृकौ पृषतान् दश। सविषाणं वसादिग्धं गजस्य च शिरो महत्॥ अवसज्यायते शूले विनदन्तं महास्वनम्।
en: Having in company with Sītā arrived at that forest abounding in terrible beasts, Kākutstha saw a man-eater, resembling a mountainsummit, emitting tremendous roars, with hollow eyes, a huge face, frightful, having a deformed belly, disgusting, dreadful, cyclopean, misshapen, of a horrible sight, clad in a tigerskin, besmeared with fat, covered with blood, capable of frightening all creatures, with his mouth widely extended, like to the Destroyer himself, and uttering loud shouts,-who stood piercing with his iron dart three lions, four tigers, two leopards, ten Prşatas, and the huge tusked head of an elephant dripping fat.

sa: निगृह्य रोष शोकं च धैर्यमाश्रित्य केवलम्। अवमानं निरस्यैनं गृहीत्वा हर्षमुत्तमम्॥ उपक्लुप्तं यदैतन्मे अभिषेकार्थमुत्तमम्। सर्वं निवर्तय क्षिप्रं कुरु कार्य निरव्ययम्॥
en: Subduing this anger and sorrow, taking recourse to patience only, brooking the insult and resorting to joy, do you set aside all those things that have been collected here for my installation and make preparations speedily for my repairing to the forest.

sa: इत्येवं लक्ष्मणे वाक्यं स्नेहाद् वदति धार्मिके। परिवादं जनन्यास्तमसहन् राघवोऽब्रवीत्॥ न तेऽम्बा मध्यमा तात गर्हितव्या कदाचन। तामेवेक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य भरतस्य कथां कुरु॥
en: As the virtuous Lakṣmaṇa was speaking thus from affection, Rāghava, not bearing the blame cast upon his mother (Kaikeyi), said, My brother, you should by no means, tax our second mother. Do you talk of that lord of the Ikşvāku race, Bharata.

sa: ततो योधाङ्गनाः सर्वा भर्तृन् सर्वान् गृहे गृहे। सज्जं तु तद् यात्रागमनमाज्ञाय त्वरयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः॥
en: Hearing of the journey to Rāma, for bringing him back the wives of the soldiers apprised of the order that had been issued to the latter, being exceedingly delighted, hurried on.

sa: भीम उवाच को भवान् किं निमित्तं वा वानरं वपुरास्थितः। ब्राह्मणानन्तरो वर्णः क्षत्रियस्त्वां तु पृच्छति॥
en: Bhima said: Who are your august self? For what reason you are in the shape of a monkey? It is a Kshatriya, an order next to the Brahmanas who asks you.

sa: राजमातुर्वचः श्रुत्वा दमयन्ती वचोऽब्रवीत्। समयेनोत्सहे वस्तुं त्वयि वीरप्रजायिनि॥ उच्छिष्टं नैव भुञ्जीयां न कुर्यां पादधावनम्। न चाहं पुरुषानन्यान् प्रभाषेयं कथंचन॥
en: Hearing these words of the Queen-mother, Damayanti spoke to her; 'O mother of heroes! I dare reside with you, provided that I shall not have to eat the remnants of a dish, nor I shall have ever to speak with other men.

sa: ह नायमफलोधर्मो नाधर्मोऽफलवानपि। दृश्यन्तेऽपि हि विद्यानां फलानि तपसां तथा॥ त्वमात्मनो विजानीहि जन्म कृष्णेयथा श्रुतम्। वेत्थ चापि यथा जातोधृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Whereas the fruits of knowledge and ascetic observances are seen, virtue and vice can never be devoid of fruits. Recollect, O Krishna, the circumstances of your birth, as you have heard and also the manner in which the powerful Dhristadyumna was born.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच के तत्रान्ये कितवा दीव्यमाना विना राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रैः। पृच्छामि त्वां विदुर ब्रूहि न स्तान् यैर्दीव्यामः शतशः संनिपत्य॥
en: Yudhishthira said Besides the sons of king Dhritarashtra who are the other dishonest gamblers that are present there to play? O Vidura, I ask you, tell us who are the men with whom we shall have to play staking hundreds upon hundreds.

sa: यैः स्म ते नाद्रियेताज्ञा न च ये शासने स्थिताः। पश्यामस्तान् श्रिया हीनान् पाण्डवान् वनवासिनः॥
en: Let us go and see the Pandavas who are now divested of their prosperity, who are now living in the forest, who never obeyed commands and who never owed you subjection.

sa: अयं च मार्गो मर्त्यानामगम्य: कुरुनन्दन। ततोऽहं रुद्धवान् मार्गं तवेमं देवसेवितम्॥ धर्षयेद् वा शपेद् वापि मा कश्चिदिति भारत। दिव्यो देवपथो ह्येष नात्र गच्छन्ति मानुषाः। यदर्थमागतश्चासि अत एव सरश्च तत्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, this passage is impassable to mortals; for this reason and as also with the view that none may defeat or curse you, I have obstructed your passage trodden by the celestials. This is one of the paths to heaven. Mortals cannot pass this way. But the lake in search of which you have come lies in that direction.

sa: स्कन्द उवाच प्रजा वो दयि कष्टं तु भवतीभिरुदाहृतम्। परिरक्षत भद्रं वः प्रजाः साधु नमस्कृताः॥
en: Skanda said: I can grant you progeny. But what you ask is very painful. Be blessed. O mothers, I bow my head to you, do give them your protection and care.

sa: तामब्रवीद् राजा कस्यासि भद्रे का वा त्वमिति। सा तां प्रत्युवाच कन्या स्मीति राजोवाचार्थी त्वयाहमिति॥
en: To her said he, “O blessed lady, who are you and to whom do you belong?" "She replied, I am a maiden." The king said, “I ask you to be mine."

sa: एवं तु विलपन्ती सा राज्ञो भार्या महात्मनः। अन्वेषमाणा भर्तारं वने श्वापदसेविते॥ उन्मत्तवद् भीमसुता विलपन्ती इतस्ततः। हा हा राजनिति मुहुरितश्चेतश्चधावति॥
en: Thus bewailing, the consort of that highsouled monarch began to search her dear lord in that forest, infested with wild beasts. Thus continuously lamenting, the daughter of Bhima ran hither and thither like an insane person, crying aloud, 'alas alas O king.'

sa: धर्म्या स्त्रियं सभा पूर्वे न नयन्तीति नः श्रुतम्। स नष्टः कौरवेयेषु पूर्वो धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: What could be more digressing to me than that through I am high born and chaste, yet I should be brought into the assembly. Where is the Dharma of these kings?

sa: विभेषि चेत् त्वमधर्मान्नरेन्द्र प्रयच्छ मे शीघ्रमेवाद्य वाम्यौ। एतच्छ्रुत्वा वामदेवस्य वाक्यं स पार्थिवः सूतमुवाच रोषात॥
en: O king, if you fear sin, then give me my Vami horses back without any delay." Having heard these words of Vamadeva, that king spoke thus to the charioteer in anger,"

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तथास्तु ते महाभागे यथा त्वं नन्दिनीच्छसि। तृतीयं वरयास्मत्तो नासि द्वाभ्यां सुसत्कृता। त्वं हि सर्वस्नुषाणां मे श्रेयसी धर्मचारिणी॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O greatly blessed girl, let it be what you say. O daughter, ask for a third boon, you have not been sufficiently honoured with two boons. Ever trading the path of virtue, you are the foremost of all my daughters-in-law.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा बहुविधैः शब्दैर्नाद्यमानां गिरेर्गुहाम्। अजातशत्रुः कौन्तेयो माद्रीपुत्रावुभावपि॥ धौम्यः कृष्णा च विप्राश्च सर्वे च सुहृदस्तथा। भीमसेनमपश्यन्तः सर्वे विमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Hearing the caves of the mountains resound with various sounds and not seeing Bhimasena, Ajatshatru (Yudhishthira), the son of Kunti and both the sons of Madri and Dhaumya and Krishna together with all the friends (of the Pandavas) became sick at heart.

sa: देवाश्च ऋषयः सिद्धाः पितरश्चापि राक्षस। गन्धर्वोरगरक्षांसि वयांसि पशवस्तथा॥ तिर्यग्योनिगताचैव अपि कीटपिपीलिकाः। मनुष्यानुपजीवन्ति ततस्त्वमपि जीवसि॥
en: O Rakshasa, the celestials, the Pitris, the Siddhas, the Rishis, the Gandharvas, the animals, even worms and ants, depend on men for their lives; you too also live (depending on men).

sa: ऋद्ध्या परमया युक्तो महेन्द्र इव वलाभृत्। यदृच्छया च तत्रस्थो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ ईजे राजर्षियज्ञेन साद्यस्केन विशाम्पते। दिव्येन विधिना चैव वन्येन कुरुसत्तम॥ कृत्वा निवेशमभितः सरसस्तस्य कौरव। द्रौपद्या सहिता धीमान् धर्मपल्या नराधिपः॥
en: The king (Duryodhana) graced with great prosperity went there like the wielder of thunder, the lord of the celestials (Indra). O foremost of the Kuru race, the greatly intelligent Dharmaraja Yudhishthira was then, O king, living near that lake and was performing with his wife Draupadi the sacrifice called Rajarshi according to the ordinance sanctioned for the celestials and persons living in the forest.

sa: ततस्तु ते क्रोधवशाः समेत्य धनेश्वरं भीमबलप्रणुनाः। भीमस्य वीर्यं च बलं च संख्ये यथावदाचख्युरतीव भीताः॥
en: (In the mean while) the Krodhavasas, being driven by the prowess of Bhima and greatly terrified, went to the lord of wealth (Kubera) and informed him of Bhima's prowess and strength.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं कुरूणामृषभो हतो भीष्मः शिखण्डिना। कथं रथात् स न्यपतत् पिता मे वासवोपमः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How has that foremost of all the Kurus Bhishma been killed by Shikhandi? How did my sire (Bhishma) who was like a second Indra fall down from his car?

sa: मृत्युरुवाच त्वया सृष्टा कथं नारी ईदृशी वदतां वर। क्रूरं कर्माहितं कुर्यां तदेव किमु जानती॥
en: Death said O most eloquent of all speakers, how shall I, created a female by you, do such heartless and mischievous deeds, knowing them at the same time to be so?

sa: दुःखानि वनवासे वा किं नु मे सुकृतं भवेत्। चोदयाश्वान् यतो भीष्मः करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: Or to suffer the woes of an exiled life, which of these should now be considered as my duty? However, O Hrishikesha, urged the steeds on, I shall do your bidding.

sa: भीष्मः शान्तनवः कन्या हरतीति पुनः पुनः॥ ये यतध्वं परं शक्त्या सर्वे मोक्षाय पार्थिवाः। प्रसह्य हि हराम्येष मिषतां वो नरर्षभाः॥
en: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, again and again takes these girls away by force; try, 0 rulers of the earth, with all your might to liberate them. By force do I take them away, O best among men, in your very sight,

sa: निष्ठुरा हीनकर्माणस्तेन हीयन्ति संयुगे। सुबहूनि नृशंसानि पुत्रैस्तव नजनेश्वर॥ निकृतानीह पाण्डूनां नीचैरिव यथा नरैः। सर्वं च तदनादृत्य पुत्राणां तव किल्बिषम्॥
en: And are cruel and of low deeds; therefore are they always worsted in the battle. O ruler of men, various heartless injuries were done to the Pandavas by your sons, like men of low extraction. Disregarding all those offences of your sons.

sa: न शशंसुजयं तत्र तावकाः पुरुषर्षभाः। अथार्जुनो रणे भीमं योधयन्तं महारथान्॥ भीष्मस्य निधनाकाक्षी पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। आससाद रणे वीरांस्तावकान् दश भारत।॥
en: Your warriors, all foremost of men, did not cherish any hope of victory then. Then Arjuna, who was proceeding desirous of slaying Bhishma, with Shikhandin before him, seeing Bhima fight with the ten mighty car-warriors of your army, confronted them in battle.

sa: सर्वेषां चैवयोधानां सामग्यं स्यान्ममाच्युत। न च मामद्य सौभद्रः प्रहृष्टो भ्रातृभिः सह। रणादायान्तुमुचितं प्रत्युद्याति हसन्निव॥
en: Or with all of our warriors, you of undeteriorating glory? Alas, today Subhadra's son accompanied by his brothers, does not come out, smiling and joyful to receive me returning from battle.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु चेदं महाराज ब्रह्मभूतं स्तवं मम। ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्च देवैश्च यः पुरा कथितो भुवि॥
en: Bhishma said Hear, O monarch, from me this hymn, chanted by Brahma himself, and recounted in the days of yore to men on earth by the Brahmanical sages and the celestial.

sa: जानामि त्वां मह बाहो क्षत्रियाणां क्षयंकर। मया श्रुतं च ते युद्धं जामदग्न्टे. वै सह॥
en: Said these words to Bhishma in battle licking at the same time the corners of his and mouth. “I know you, O mighty-armed hero, to be the destroyer of the Kshatriyas.

sa: रामेण सह मा योत्सीगुरुणेति पुनः पुनः। न हि रामो रणे जेतुं त्वया न्याय्यः कुरूद्वह॥
en: "Do not fight with Rama, your preceptor", again and again (saying this). It is not becoming for you, O perpetuator of the race of Kuru, to vanquish Rama in battle. one.

sa: तस्मात्तु मान्धातेत्येवं नाम तस्याद्भुतं कृतम्। ततस्तु धारां पयसो धृतस्य च महात्मनः॥ तस्यास्ये यौवनाश्वस्य पाणिरिन्द्रस्य चास्रवत्। अपिबत् पाणिमिन्द्रस्य स चाप्यहाभ्यवर्धत॥
en: Therefore the celestials designated him as Mandhatri. Then streams of milk and clarified butter flowed into the mouth of Yuvanasva's son from the finger of the high-souled Indra. He then drank the nectar flowing from Indra's hand and thus went on growing.

sa: अपि॥ शक्या समाधातुं संनिपाते दुर्निवा तदा चैव प्रभग्ना महती चमूः। अपामिव महावेगास्त्रस्ता मृगगणा इव॥
en: If a large ariny is once broken up and rouled, it cannot be easily rallied like a herd of deer in a fright or a mighty current of waters (in rains).

sa: तथा गदश्च साम्बश्च प्रद्युम्नोऽथ विदूरथः। अगावहोऽनिरुद्धश्च चारुदेष्णः ससारणः॥ उल्मुको निशठश्चैव झिल्ली बभ्रुश्च वीर्यवान्। पृथुश्च विपृथुश्चैद शमीकोऽथारिमेजय॥ एतेऽन्ये बलवन्तश्च वृष्णिवीराः प्रहारिणः। कथंचित् पाण्डवानीकं श्रयेयुः समरे स्थिताः॥ आहूता वृष्णिवीरेण केशवेन महात्मना। ततः संशयितं सर्वे भवेदिति मतिर्मम॥
en: Then also Gada, Shamva, Pradyumna, Viduratha, Agaboha Anirudina, Charudeshna along with Sarana, Ulmuka, Nisata, the powerful Jhilhivobhru, Prithu, Viprithu, Somika and Arimejaya. These and other most puissant Vrishni heroes, skilled in the art of smiting, will, standing on the field, betake to the ranks of the Pandava host. Being called to do so by that foremost of Vrishni warriors, viz., Keshava of high soul; then me-seems, everything (on my side) will be in great dangers.

sa: तथा प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे धनुरुद्यम्य दंशितः। अभिपत्य महाबाहुर्भीष्मो भीमपराक्रमः॥ सौभद्रे भीमसेने च सात्यकौ च महारथे। कैकेये च विराटे च धृष्टद्युम्ने च पार्षते॥ एतेषु नरवीरेषु चेदिमत्स्येषु चाभिभूः। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि वृद्धः कुरुपितामहः॥
en: When the battle thus began, the venerable Kuru grandfather, the mighty-armed and terribly powerful Bhishma, clad in armour, took up his bow and rushed upon them. He poured a shower of arrows on the heroic son of Subhadra, on Bhimasena, on the great carwarrior Arjuna, on the ruler of the Kaikeyas, Virata, Prishata prince Dhrishtadyumna and also on the Chedi and the Matsya warriors.

sa: शाईका ऊचुः न विद्महे हृतं मातः श्येनेनाखुं कथंचन। अविज्ञाय न शक्यामः प्रवेष्टुं विवरं भुवः॥
en: The Sharangakas said : O mother, we do know whether the mouse has been really carried away by the hawk. We cannot enter the hole in the grounds without knowing it.

sa: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय निश्चक्राम महायशाः॥ सापि कालेन कौसल्या सुषुवेऽन्धं तमात्मजम्। पुनरेव तु सा देवी परिभाष्य स्नुषां ततः॥ ऋषिमावाहयत् सत्या यथा पूर्वमरिंदम! ततस्तेनैव विधिना महर्षिस्तामपद्यत॥ अम्बालिकामथाभ्यागादृषि दृष्ट्वा च सापि तम्। विवर्णा पाण्डुसंकाशा समपद्यत भारत॥
en: Having promised this, the illustrious (Vyasa) went away. In due time the princess of Kosalya gave birth to a blind son. O chastiser of foes, after securing the consent of her daughter-in-law, Satyavati soon after again summoned Vyasa as she did before. Vyasa came according to his promise and went to the second wife (Ambalika) of his brother in proper form. But she became pale and discoloured with fear on seeing the Rishi.

sa: स्वयमुत्थाय चैवाथ हृदयेन क्षुरोपमः। स वाचामृतकल्पश्च भ्रातृवच्च सुहृद् यथा॥ स्वयं प्रक्षिपते भक्ष्यं बहु भीमस्य पापकृत्। प्रतीच्छितं स्म भीमेन तं वै दोषमजानता॥ ततो दुर्योधनस्तत्र हृदयेन हसन्निवा कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मन्यते पुरुषाधमः॥
en: That wicked youth, whose heart was a razor, but whose tongue was ambrosia, rose like a (loving) brother and friend. The wicked man himself fed (Bhima) with a large quantity of it. Bhima too ate it, knowing that there was nothing wrong. Thereupon Duryodhana felt himself very happy in his mind; that worst of men thought that he had compassed his end.
