sa: बार्हद्रथो जरासंधस्तद् विद्धि भरतर्षभ। न चैनमनुरुद्ध्यन्ते कुलान्येकशतं नृपाः। तस्मादिह बलादेव साम्राज्यं कुरुते हि सः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the son of Brihadratha, Jarasandha, is (also) one such (a candidate for the imperial dignity). One hundred families of kings have failed to oppose him.

sa: तौ राजभवनद्वारि न प्राप्तौ नृगशासनम्॥ अहोरात्राण्यनेकानि वसन्तौ क्रोधमीयतुः। ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ तावुभौ द्विजसत्तमौ। क्रुद्धौ परमसंप्राप्तौ वाक्यं घोराभिसंहतम्॥ अर्थिनां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं यस्मात्त्वं नैषि दर्शनम्। अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां कृकलासो भविष्यसि ॥ बहुवर्षसहस्राणि बहुवर्षशतानि च। श्वभ्रे त्वं कृकलीभूो दीर्घकालं निवत्स्यसि॥
en: And though they waited for a long time at the gate they did not obtain permission to enter the palace. Thereat both of them were greatly enraged and imprecated dreadful curses, saying Since you have not granted us an interview though we have been waiting here for a long time, you shall, by our curse, remain invisible, being a lizard. You shall in this state live in a den for many hundred and thousand years.

sa: त्रयोदशानां पत्नीनां या तु दाक्षायणी वरा। मारीचः कश्यपस्त्वस्यामादित्यान् समजीजनत्॥ इन्द्रादीन् वीर्यसम्पन्नान् विवस्वन्तमथापि च। विवस्वतः सुतो जज्ञे यमो वैवस्वतः प्रभुः॥
en: Kashyapa, the son of Marichi, begot on his wife, the daughter of Daksha, who was the eldest among his thirteen wives, Aditya, the greatly effulgent celestials, Indra, being at their head and Vaivasvata also, Vaivasvata's son was born Yama, the great lord.

sa: गान्धार्युवाच ज्येष्ठं कुन्तीसुतं जातं श्रुत्वा रविसमप्रभम्॥ दुःखेन परमेणेदमुदरं घातितं मया। शतं च किल पुत्राणां वितीर्णं मे त्वया पुरा॥ इयं मे मांसपेशी जाता पुत्रशताय वै।
en: Gandhari said : Having heard that Kunti had first given birth to a son, as effulgent as the sun. I struck at my womb in grief. You granted me the boon that I should get one hundred sons. But a ball of flesh has come out in the place of one hundred sons.

sa: यदाश्रौषं कर्णदुर्योधनाभ्यां बुद्धिं कृतां निग्रहे केशवस्या तं चात्मानं बहुधा दर्शयानं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Karna and Duryodhana had determined to make Krishna a prisoner, but he had shown the whole universe in himself.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं पुत्रशतं जज्ञे गान्धार्यां द्विजसत्तम। कियता चैव कालेन तेषामायुश्च किं परम्॥ वै॥
en: Janamejaya said : O best of the twice born, why did Gandhari give birth to one hundred sons? In how many years (they were born)? What was their period of life?

sa: दुष्यन्त उवाच इच्छामि त्वां वरारोहे भजमानामनिन्दिते। त्वदर्थं मां स्थितं विद्धि त्वद्गतं हि मनो मम॥
en: Dushyanta said : O beautiful lady, O faultless beauty, I desire that you yourself should accept me. Know that I exist for you. Know also, my heart is completely in you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो यथोक्तं द्रोणेन तत् सर्वं कृतमञ्जसा॥ तदवेक्ष्य कुमारास्ते विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः। आश्चर्यमिदमत्यन्तमिति मत्वा वचोऽब्रुवन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then Drona did exactly what he had said. The princes were all amazed and their eyes expanded with delight. Regarding what they saw as very extraordinary, they said-

sa: ययातिरुवाच यदन्तरिक्षं पृथिवी दिशश्च यत्तेजसा तपते भानुमांश्च। लोकास्तावन्तो दिवि संस्थिता वै ते नान्तवन्तः प्रतिपालयन्ति॥
en: Yayati said : The extensive regions, as extensive as those in the firmament, on earth and ten points of heaven that are illuminated by the sun, are all waiting for you.

sa: तं तु सुतं पुरोद्याने गङ्गायां प्रक्षिपामहे। अथ तस्मादवरजं श्रेष्ठं चैव युधिष्ठिरम्॥ प्रसह्य बन्धने बद्ध्वा प्रशासिष्ये वसुंधराम्। एवं स निश्चयं पापः कृत्वा दुर्योधनस्तदा। नित्यमेवान्तरप्रेक्षी भीमस्यासीन्महात्मनः॥
en: Therefore, when he will be asleep in the gardens of the palace, we shall throw him into the Gangas. Afterwards confining his eldest brother Yudhisthira and his younger brother (Arjuna), I shall reign soie king over the earth.' Duryodhana, having determined to do this wicked act, watched for an opportunity to injure Bhima.

sa: शप्त्वा च तान् महाभागस्तपस्येव मनो दधे। एवं स शप्तवान् राजन् वसूनष्टौ तपोधनः॥ महाप्रभावो ब्रह्मर्षिर्दैवान् क्रोधसमन्वितः। अथाश्रमपदं प्राप्तास्ते वै भूयो महात्मनः॥ शप्ताः स्म इति जानन्त ऋषिं तमुपचक्रमुः। प्रसादयन्तस्तमृषि वसवः पार्थिवर्षभ।॥ लेभिरे न च तस्मात् ते प्रसादमृषिसत्तमात्। आपवात् पुरुषव्याघ्र सर्वधर्मविशारदात्॥
en: Having thus cursed them, the illustrious man again engaged himself in asceticism. O king, when the celestial Vasus were thus cursed in anger by that Brahmarshi and ascetic of great power. They soon came to the hermitage of the illustrious man; as soon as they came to know of it. O best of men, Apava, learned in the ruled of every virtue. O best of kings, the Vasus tried to pacify that Rishi, but they failed to obtain grace from that best of Rishis.

sa: एवमस्त्विति तं चापि प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरः। ते रथैर्नगराकारैर्देशजैश्च गजोत्तमैः॥ निर्युयुर्नगराच्छूराः कौरवाः पाण्डवैः सह। उद्यानवनमासाद्य विसृज्य च महाजनम्॥ विशन्ति स्म तदा वीराः सिंहा इव गिरेर्गुहाम्। उद्यानमभिपश्यन्तो भ्रातरः सर्व एव ते॥
en: Yudhisthira replied by saying, “Let it be so." The Kurus with the Pandavas, mounted on cars resembling cities and on excellent native elephants, left the town. Arriving at that garden and wood, they dismissed their attendants. They surveyed the beauty of the garden and the wood; and then those heroes, all the brothers, entered the palace as lions enter the mountain caves.

sa: अजातशत्रुश्च कुरुप्रवीरः पप्रच्छ कृष्णं कुशलं विलोक्य। कथं वयं वासुदेव त्वयेह गूढा वसन्तो विदिताश्च सर्वे॥
en: Seeing Krishna, Ajatashatru, that foremost of the Kuru race, asked him his well-fare and said “O Vasudeva, how have you been able to trace us, living as we are in disguise?”

sa: तातेऽपि हि गते स्वर्ग विनष्टे च ममानुजे। पिण्डः पितॄणां व्युच्छिद्येत् तत् तेषां विप्रियं भवेत्॥
en: If you, my father, ascend to heaven, if my brother dies, the Pinda (funeral cake) for the Pitris (ancestors) will be stopped and it will be most unfavourite act of theirs.

sa: भगदत्त उवाच कुन्तीमातर्यथां मे त्वं तथा राजा युधिष्ठिरः। सर्वमेतत् करिष्यामि किं चान्यत् करवाणि ते॥
en: Bhagadatta said O son of Kunti, as you are to me, so is also the king Yudhishthira. I shall do all this; tell me what else I can do for you.

sa: दुर्योधनं समागच्छन्नर्हणानि ततस्ततः। मणिकाञ्चनरत्नानि गोहस्त्यश्वधनानि च॥ विचित्राणि च वासांसि प्रावारावरणानि च। कम्बलाजिनरत्नानि राङ्कवास्तरणानि च॥ समृद्धां तां तथा दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां तदा श्रियम्। ईर्ष्यासमुत्थः सुमहांस्तस्य मन्युरजायत॥
en: Duryodhana came to this sacrifice. When he saw on all sides the great wealth of the Pandavas, the offerings, the precious stones, gold and jewels, elephants and horses; valuable textures, garments and mantles; shawls and furs, carpets made of the skin of the Ranku, he was filled with envy and became very angry.

sa: नारद उवाच एवं तौ सहितौ भूत्वा सर्वार्थेष्वेकनिश्चयौ॥ तिलोत्तमार्थं संक्रुद्धावन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः। तस्माद् ब्रवीमि वः स्नेहात् सर्वान् भरतसत्तमाः॥ यथा वो नात्र भेदः स्यात् सर्वेषां द्रौपदीकृते। तथा कुरुत भद्रं वो मम चेत् प्रियमिच्छथ॥
en: Thus those two Asuras, ever united and inspired with the same purpose, killed each other in anger for the sake of Tilottama. O best of the Bharata race, therefore, from affection for you all, I tell you that if you wish to do anything agreeable to me, make some such arrangement as you may not quarrel with one another for the sake of Draupadi.

sa: ततः पितामहो वाणी त्वन्तरिक्षादभाषत। आगच्छ विष्णो भद्रं ते दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव।।। भ्रातृभिः सह देवाभैः प्रविशस्व स्विकां तनुम्। यामिच्छसि महाबाहो तां तनुं प्रविश स्विकाम्।।९ वैष्णवीं तां महातेजो यद्वाकाशं सनातनम्। त्वं हि लोकगतिर्देव न त्वां केचित्प्रजानते॥ ऋते मायां विशालाक्षीं तव पूर्वपरिग्रहाम्। त्वामचिन्त्यं महद्भूतमक्षयं चाजरं तथा। यामिच्छसि महातेजस्तां तनुं प्रविश स्वयम्॥
en: There upon the Patriarch gave vent to the following accents from the welkin:-Come O Visnu; may good betide you; by our good fortune you are coming here; O Raghava hearO you having mighty arms, do you enter here with your brothers, resembling the celestials in brilliance in whatever from you like either in that of the sky or in your own Vişņu form. You are the refuge of the creatures nobody know you. You are above the range of thought; great immortal and imperishable; nobody know you save Maya, having wide eyes, your former spouse. Do you enter here yourself in whatever effulgent form you like.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो दानेन तपसा च ह। युधिष्ठिर गताः स्वर्गे निवर्तन्ते पुनः पुनः॥
en: These and many other men, O Yudhishthira, have attained to the celestial region, by the merit of their charities and penances and they have also returned from there again and again.

sa: पुनर्विव्याध विंशत्या सायकानां हसन्निव। कृतवर्मा ततो राजन् सर्वतस्तान् महारथान्॥ एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्धवा भीमं विव्याध सप्तभिः। धनुर्ध्वजं चास्य तथा रथाद् भूमावपातयत्॥
en: He then once more smilingly pierced him with twenty shafts. Thereupon, Oking, Kritavarman piercing each of these mighty carwarriors separately with five shafts, pierced Bhima with another seven shafts. Then he felled from the latter's car his standard and cutoff his bow.

sa: न दाशार्ही सुधर्मा वा ब्रह्मणो वाथ तादृशी। सभा रूपेण सम्पन्ना यां चक्रे मतिमान् मयः॥
en: The Sudharma (the assembly-hall) of the Dasharhas (Vrishnis)-nay even the abode of Brahma was not so grand and endued with so much beauty as this assembly-hall built by the intelligent Maya.

sa: युयुत्सुना महेन्द्रेण पुंसा सार्धं महात्मना। ततो मे भगवान् दृष्टो हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः॥ वैकुण्ठः पुरुषोऽनन्तः शुक्लो विष्णुः सनातनः। मुञ्जकेशो हरिश्मश्रुः सर्वभूतपितामहः॥
en: Desirous of fighting the great Indra, the great ruler of the celestial region, I beheld in that battle the illustrious Hari, the powerful Narayana, He who is called Vaikuntha, Purusha, Ananta, Shukla, Vishnu, Sanatana, Munjakesha, Harishmashru, and the Grandsire of all creatures.

sa: न्यर्बुदं रक्षसामत्र उत्तरद्वारमाश्रितम्। रथिनश्चाश्ववाहाश्च कुलपुत्राः सुपूजिताः॥ शतशोऽथ सहस्राणि मध्यमं स्कन्धमाश्रिताः। यातुधाना दुराधर्षाः साग्रकोटिश्च रक्षसाम्॥
en: And an arbuda of Rākṣasas protect the Northern gate. And car-warriors and horsemenpersons honoured and sprung from noble linesby hundreds and thousands,tand irrepressible goblins and koțis of Rākşasas, protect the garrison.

sa: न चाप्यहं त्वया लभ्या गन्धर्वाः पतयो मम। ते त्वां निहन्युः कुपिता: साध्वलं मा व्यनीनशः॥४८
en: I am not to be won by you; I have Gandharvas for my husband, they, if enraged, shall slay you. It is good for you not to bring destruction upon yourself.

sa: ततस्तामब्रवीत् कृष्णः क्षुधितोऽस्मि भृशातुरः। शीघ्रं भोजय मां कृष्णे पश्चात् सर्वं करिष्यसि॥ निशम्य तद्वचः कृष्णा लज्जिता वाक्यमब्रवीत्। स्थाल्यां भास्करदत्तायामन्नं मद्भोजनावधि॥ भुक्तवत्यस्म्यहं देव तस्मादन्नं न विद्यते।
en: “Thereupon Krishna said to her, I am greatly stricken with hunger; soon feed me, O Krishna and afterwards I shall do all.” Hearing his words Krishna, ashamed, said, The vessel given by the sun remains full till I take my meals. O lord, I have taken my meals and there is no food.

sa: इति राम निवेदितं तु ते भयजं कारणमुत्थितं च यत्। विनिवारयितुं भवान्क्षमः कुरु तं काममहीनविक्रम॥
en: Thus, O Rāma, have we acquainted you with the occasion of fear that has arisen. You are capable of coping with the same. Do you of undeteriorated prowess, do the needful.

sa: निशम्य वाक्यं तु जनार्दनस्य धर्मार्थयुक्तं मधुरं समं च॥ समाददे वाक्यमथाग्रजोऽस्य सम्पूज्य वाक्यं तदतीव राजन्॥
en: Hearing this speech of Janardana which was pregnant with meaning and virtue, interesting and impartial, his elder brother accepted the suggestions and after praising the speech addressed him O king, thus.

sa: धर्मराजमुवाचेदं व्रतमादिश मे प्रभो। समयः समतिक्रान्तो भवत्संदर्शने मया।॥ वनवासो गमिष्यामि समयो ह्येष नः कृतः।
en: He then said to Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), “O Lord, give me permission to observe the vow. The rule that was established by us has been violated by me on my seeing you.

sa: भीष्मं द्रोणं कृपं द्रौणिं दुर्योधनविविंशती। अस्मिन् यज्ञे भवन्तो मामनुगृहणन्तु सर्वशः॥
en: Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, the son of Drona (Ashvathama), Duryodhana and Vivanshati. “But all of you gracious to me in my this sacrifice.

sa: तं रथेन नरश्रेष्ठ सम्पादय महारथम्। ततो दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा भारत दुर्मुखः॥
en: Do you supply that mighty car-warrior, that foremost of men with a chariot.” Thereupon, O Bharata, hearing the words of Duryodhana, Durmukha.

sa: औरसो भवतः पुत्रो युयुत्सुनृपसत्तम। अस्तु राजा महाराज यमन्यं मन्यते भवान्॥
en: O best of kings, let Yuyutsu, the son of your loins, be made king, or indeed, anybody else whom you may wish.

sa: दुर्विज्ञेयं पदं तात विष्णोरमिततेजसः। कथं वा राजशार्दूल पदं तु ज्ञातवानसौ।२।।
en: The position occupied by Vishnu of immeasurable energy is difficult, of being perceived. How, O foremost of kings, could Vritra comprehend it?

sa: कर्ण उवाच को मामेवं भवान् प्राह दर्शयन् सौहृदं परम्। कामया भगवन् ब्रूहि को भवान् द्विजवेषधृक्॥
en: Karna said: Who are you, that, showing so great an affection for me, are addressing me thus? Tell me, O god, if you desire, who you are in the shape of a Brahmana.

sa: त्वामेव पुरुषव्याघ्रं लोके सन्तः प्रचक्षते। नाशक्यं विद्यते लोके सात्यकेरिति माधव॥
en: The wise speak of you, O foremost of all male beings, saying-There is nothing unachievable by Satyaki, O descendant of Madhu's race.

sa: तस्याः पुत्रो महावीर्यो लवणो नाम दारुणः। बाल्यात्प्रभृति दुष्टात्मा पापान्येव समाचरत्॥
en: Her son, the highly powerful wicked, and fierce Lavana, ever since his boyhood, gave himself up to a sinful course of life.

sa: एतन्मे संशयं ब्रूहि पृच्छते भरतर्षभ। वृत्रस्तु राजशार्दूल यथा शक्रेण निर्जितः॥
en: O king of the Bharatas, remove this my doubt! Indeed, tell me, O foremost of kings, how Vritra was defeated by Shakra.

sa: न चापि वयमुग्रेण कर्मणा वचनेन वा। प्रभ्रष्टाः प्रणमामेह भयादपि शतक्रतुम्॥
en: We will not, fearing harsh deeds or words, bow down out of fear even to the performer of a hundred sacrifices (Indra).

sa: एवमुक्तो धिगित्येव राजा दशरथोऽब्रवीत्। वीडितश्च जनः सर्वः सा च तनावबुध्यत॥
en: Thus addressed, king Dasaratha said, "O fire!" and all present were afflicted with shame: but Kaikeyi feigned not to understand all this.

sa: शब्दः स्पर्शस्तथा रूपं रसो गन्धश्च पञ्चमः। क्रियाः करणनित्याः स्युरनित्या मोहसंज्ञिताः॥
en: Sound, touch, colour, taste, and smell numbering the fifth, are effects. They are, however, inconstant, and called by the name of delusion.

sa: पाण्डवा ऊचुः कथं दुपदपुत्रस्य धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पावकात्। वेदीमध्याच्च कृष्णायाः सम्भवः कथमद्भुतः॥
en: The Pandavas said : O Brahmana, how did the birth of Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Drupada, take place from the (sacrificial) fire?

sa: सात्यकिं च रणे दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तमभीवत्। किं नु दुर्योधनः कृत्यं प्राप्तकालममन्यत॥
en: Beholding also Satyaki dash through his troops like one fearless, what measures also did Duryodhana consider to be suitable to the situation?

sa: त्रिणस्तु नरेन्द्रस्य रात्रिं परमसत्कृताः। ऊषुः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे गुणैः सर्वैः समन्विताः॥
en: And excellently ministered to, the counsellors of that foremost of monarchs (Janaka), endowed with every excellent quality, spent that night in joy.

sa: अनादृत्य तु राजानं गते मयि न संशयः। अजातशत्रोर्नृपतेर्मम चैवानृतं भवेत्॥
en: There is no doubt that if I enter (the room) disregarding the king, I shall not truthfully behave towards that enemiless monarch.

sa: नहि वः प्लवने कश्चिन्नापि कश्चित् पराक्रमे। तुल्यः सामरदैत्येषु लोकेषु हरिसत्तमाः॥
en: You foremost of monkeys, there is none among the celestials or Asuras who can equal you either in leaping or in prowess.

sa: संकल्पेषु निरारम्भो निराशो निर्ममो भव। अशोकं स्थानमातिष्ठ इह चामुत्र चाव्ययम्॥
en: Relying, therefore, upon that which is the eternal source of joy both here and hereafter, leave off all actions and attachment thereto.

sa: मुष्टिना शरभं हत्वा जानुना नीलमाहवे। आजघान गवाक्षं तु तलेनेन्द्ररिपुस्तदा ॥
en: Then the enemy of Indra smite, Sarabha with blow, and Nila, in the conflict with his thigh, struck a slap at Gavākṣa.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच अहंकारात् प्रसूतानि महाभूतानि पञ्च वै। पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्॥
en: Brahman said From Egoism were, indeed, born the five great elements. They are earth, air, ether, water and light numbering the fifth.

sa: अभ्यधावन्त संक्रुद्धाः केकयाः पञ्च सोदराः। तानभ्यापततः प्रेक्ष्य तव पुत्रा महारथाः॥
en: Thereupon the five Kaikeya princes excited with rage, rushed (to the rescue of Shatanika). Beholding them advance, your sons all mighty car-warriors.

sa: घटोत्कचस्तु संक्रुद्धो दृष्ट्वा चक्रं निपातितम्॥ कर्णं प्राच्छादयद् बाणैः स्वार्भानुरव भास्करम्।
en: Beholding his discus thus baffled, Ghatotkacha was highly enraged and he then covered Karna with his arrows like Rahu covering the sun.

sa: क्व च ते भ्रातरो मह्यं तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि। देशोऽयं कश्च देवानामेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: You should tell me where those brothers, of mine are. I wish also to know what region is this of the celestials.

sa: न संतापस्त्वया कार्यः सौमित्रे मैथिली प्रति। दृष्टमेतत्पुरा विप्रैः पितुस्ते लक्ष्मणाग्रतः॥
en: Be not aggrieved for Sītā, O Saumitri Formerly in the presence of your sire the Brāhmaṇas related this account of Sītā's exile.

sa: शिवं महापुण्यमिदं दिवौकसां सुसम्मतं सर्वगुणैः समन्वितम्। अतश्च सर्वे निहता नृपा रणे यास्यन्ति पुण्यां गतिमक्षयां सदा॥
en: This place endued with all virtues is auspicious and highly sacred, and is much respected by the celestials. It is for this that Kshatriyas slain in battle here obtain sacred and blissful regions.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु यत्तेषु भरतर्षभ। धृतराष्ट्रो महाराज संजयं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The army having been prepared in order for battle, 0 Bharata, the great king Dhritarashtra said these words to Sanjaya.

sa: नापराध्यति बीभत्सुर्न च पार्थो वृकोदरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च नैव जातु युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: In this matter Vibhatsu of Pritha's son Vrikodara, or Nakula Or Sahadeva, Or Yudhishthira himself is not to blame in the least.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सुबलपुत्रस्तु राजा दुर्योधनश्च ह। दुःशासनश्च कर्णश्च दुष्टं मन्त्रममन्त्रयन्॥ ते कौरव्यमनुज्ञाप्य धृतराष्ट्र नराधिपम्। दहने तु सपुत्रायः कुन्त्या बुद्धिमकारयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon after consulting with one another the son of Subala (Sakuni) king Duryodhana, Dushasana and Karna formed and evil conspiracy. They resolved with the sanction of the descendant of Kuru the king Dhritarashtra to burn to death Kunti with her sons.

sa: पाञ्चाल्यौ सात्यकिश्चैव सहसा समुपाद्रवन्। उपायान्तं तु राधेयं दृष्ट्वा पार्थो महारथः॥
en: The two Panchala princes and Satyaki came up to him. Seeing the son of Radha rush (against him), the mighty car-warrior Partha.

sa: स च म्लेच्छाधमः पापो दग्धस्तत्र पुरोचनः। वञ्चिताश्च दुरात्मानो धार्तराष्ट्रा: सहानुगाः॥
en: The worst of Mlecchas, the sinful Purochana, was also burnt to death. Thus were deceived the sons of Dhritarashtra with their counsellors.

sa: तस्मै हस्त्युत्तमांश्चित्रान् कम्बलानजिनानि च। सत्कृत्य केकयो राजा भरताय ददौ धनम्॥
en: Then honouring Bharata, king Kekaya conferred on Bharata wealth consisting of choice elephants maintained (at the palace) and woollen sheets and deerskins.

sa: पाञ्चालक सुदुर्वृत्त ममेव गुरुमग्रतः॥ गुरोर्गुरुं च भूयोऽपि क्षिपन्नैव हि लजसे।
en: Ill-mannered wretch of Panchala, villifying my own preceptor in the first instance and then my preceptor's preceptor, why don't you feel ashamed?

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यद् वृत्तं तीर्थयात्रायां शपथं प्रति तच्छृणु॥
en: Bhishina said Regarding it is cited the old history of the oaths on the occasion of a sojourn to the sacred waters.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति कन्यां तु पार्थिवे होत्रवाहने। अकृतव्रणः प्रादुरासीद् रामस्यानुचरः प्रियः॥
en: While Hotravahana that ruler of the earth was thus speaking to that girl, the devoted follower of Rama, Akritavrana, presented himself there.

sa: हरता मैथिली येन मां च रोषयता ध्रुवम्। आत्मनो जीवितान्ताय मृत्युद्वारमपावृतम्॥
en: He, that has carried off Mithila's daughter, and roused my wrath, has certainly for his own end, opened the door of death.

sa: ततो दुःखतरं भूयः सीताया विप्रवासनम्। पौराणां वचनं श्रुत्वा नृशंसं प्रतिभाति मे॥ को नु धर्माश्रयः सूत कर्मण्यस्मिन्यशोहरे। मैथिली समनुप्राप्तः पौरे नार्थवादिभिः॥
en: But this banishment of Sītā appears to me as exceedingly painful and most ruthless. O charioteer, the opinion of the citizens is by no means just; consequently what shall we gain by performing such a bad action for fame as the exile of Sita?

sa: स प्रदाय महीं तस्मै कश्यपाय महात्मने। अस्मिन् महेन्द्रे शैलेन्द्रे वसत्यमितविक्रमः॥
en: O king, having bestowed the earth on the illustrious Kashyapa, he engaged in severe austerities on the Mahendra, the foremost of mountains.

sa: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्या संत्यक्तं ह्रियमाणया। उत्तरीयमिदं भूमौ शरीराद् भूषणानि च॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, behold this scarf and these ornaments which Vaidehī, while being carried away, let fall from her person to the earth.

sa: तद्विनाशेऽपि मे दुखं प्रमृष्टं स्यादनन्तरम्। सुखं मे जीवितं चैव तद्विनाशनिबन्धनम्॥
en: Even by his death my present pain would be removed. Both my life and my happiness are bound up with his death.

sa: ततः प्रीतोऽभवद् राजा श्रुत्वा तु द्विजभाषितम्। अमात्यानब्रवीद् राजा हर्षेणेदं शुभाक्षरम्॥
en: Hearing those words of the regenerate ones, the king was exceedingly delighted. And cheerfully he spoke these auspicious words to his courtiers.

sa: अवरुह्य रथात् तूर्णं ध्रियमाणं बलीयसा॥ उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा सहदेवो विशाम्पते।
en: Then, Oking, Sahadeva jumping down from his car, addressed Satyaki held in check by the strong arms of Bhima, in these soothing

sa: ते मन्त्रयितुमारब्धास्तत्रासीना दिवौकसः। अमृताय समागम्य तपोनियमसंयुताः॥ तत्र नारायणो देवो ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रवीत्। चिन्तयत्सु सुरेष्वेवं मन्त्रयत्सु च सर्वशः॥
en: They, who had practised penances and observed vows, came in quest of the Ambrosia. They consulted together about the possession of the Ambrosia and seeing them in this mood Narayana addressed Brahma saying;

sa: अतो हास्यतरं लोके किंचिदन्यन्न विद्यते। यत्र दुर्जनमित्याह दुर्जनः सज्जनं स्वयम्॥
en: What could be more ridiculous in the world than this, that those that are wicked should represent really honest men as wicked.

sa: यदा स्वमुखमादर्श विकृतं सोऽभिवीक्षते। तदान्तरं विजानीते आत्मानं चेतरं जनम्।। ८८
en: But when he sees his own face in the mirror, it is then that he perceives the difference between himself and others.

sa: विव्याध नृपतिं तूर्णं सप्तभिर्निशितैः शरैः। तदप्यस्य धनुः क्षिप्रं चिच्छेद लघुहस्तवत्॥
en: Pierced quickly the king with seven sharpened arrows. But he (i.e. Duryodhana), displaying great nimbleness of hand, quickly cut-off that bow also.

sa: अथ मामब्रवीद् भूयः स मुनिः संशितव्रतः। कृष्ण पायसमिच्छामि भोक्तुमित्येव सत्वरः॥
en: Of highly praiseworthy vows, he met me shortly after this and addressing me, said, O Krishna, I wish to cal frumenty forthwith.

sa: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल तमायुधविनाकृतम्। अप्रविष्टं पुरं पूर्वं द्वारि तिष्ठ धृतायुधः॥ अप्रविष्टं च भवनं युद्धाय पुरुषर्षभ। आह्वयेथा महाबाहो ततो हन्तासि राक्षसम्॥
en: Therefore, O foremost of men, you should, before entering the city, stand at the gate obstructing his course. O you having long arms, you should invite him for battle when he shall be weaponless and in that way would be able to destroy him.

sa: दातिसारा दरदाः पुण्ड्राश्चैव सहस्रशः। तेन शक्याः स्म संख्यातुं व्रात्याः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Many other Dravatisaras, Daradas, Pundras, thousands in number in bands of hundreds and thousands and together forming a force that was innumerable.

sa: स ललाटे शरो मग्नतस्य भीमस्य रक्षसः। ददृशे शोणितेनाक्तः पन्नगेन्द्र इवाचले।७३।।
en: That arrow piercing the forehead of that dreadful Raksasas, and smeared with blood, appeared like the lord of serpents in a mountain.

sa: प्राक्रोशन् क्षत्रियास्तत्र दृष्ट्वा तद् वैशसं महत्। दुर्योधनापराधेन गच्छन्ति क्षत्रियाः क्षयम्॥
en: Then in that battle the Kshatriyas beholding that awful carnage, exclaimed saying. Through the folly of Duryodhana, Kshatriyas are being thus destroyed.

sa: प्रमदाभ्यो वरा सा तु सत्त्वरूपगुणान्विता। ततः प्रमद्वरेत्यस्या नाम चक्रे महानृषिः॥
en: As the surpassed all other ladies in beauty in goodness and in every good quality, the gave her the name as Pramadvara.

sa: अकस्मानागरः सर्वो जनो दैन्यमुपागमत्। आहारे वा विहारे वा न कश्चिदकरोन्मनः॥
en: And all of a sudden the citizens have been stricken with poverty: and no one turns his thoughts to eating or drinking.

sa: ततो दुःखतरं किं नु राघवस्य भविष्यति। पत्नी शुद्धसमाचारां विसृज्य जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: His spouse-the daughter of Janaka, is perfectly pure; what can be more painful than that Rāma is living alone having renounced her?

sa: आश्लेषायां ददच्छ्राद्धं धीरान् पुत्रान् प्रजायते। ज्ञातीनां तु भवेच्छ्रेष्ठो मघासु श्राद्धमावपन्॥
en: By doing it under the constellation Ashlesha one begets heroic children. By doing it under the Maghas onc gains superiority over kinsmen.

sa: त्वां तु दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं परिष्वज्य सलक्ष्मणम्। अद्य दुःखाद्विमुक्तोऽस्मि नीहारादिव भास्करः॥
en: Beholding you all well and embracing you with Lakşmaņa I am now shorn of grief like to the Sun, devoid of dues.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तु तच्चक्रे भीमो नृपतिशासनम्। हृष्टः श्रुत्वा गुडाकेशमायान्तं पुरुषर्षभम्॥
en: Thus addressed, Bhima obeyed the royal command He became very glad upon hearing that Arjuna of curly hair was about to retum.

sa: जम्बुक उवाच असकृद् यतितो ह्येष हन्तुं व्याघ्र वने त्वया।॥ युवा वै जवसम्पन्नो बुद्धिशाली न शक्यते। मूषिकोऽस्य शयानस्य चरणौ भक्षयत्वयम्॥ यथैनं भक्षितैः पादैर्व्याघ्रो गृहणातु वै ततः। ततो वै भक्षयिष्यामः सर्वे मुदितमानसाः॥
en: The Jackal said : O tiger, you have made many attempts to seize this deer, but your efforts were in vain, for this deer is young, fleet and intelligent. Let the mouse go and eat into its feet when it is asleep. When his feet will be thus eaten, let the tiger go and seize it. Then we shall all eat it with a delightful heart.

sa: स त्वं हत्वा मधुसुतं लवणं पापनिश्चयम्॥ राज्यं प्रशाधि धर्मेण वाक्यं मे यद्यवेक्षसे। उत्तरं च न वक्तव्यं शूर वाक्यान्तरे मम॥ बालेन पूर्वजस्याज्ञा कर्तव्या नात्र संशयः। अभिषेकं च काकुत्स्थ प्रतीच्छस्व ममोद्यतम्। वसिष्ठप्रमुखैविप्रैर्विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: So if you accept my words, then slaying Madhu's son, the sinful Lavana, rule the kingdom righteously. O hero, you must say anything after what I have spoken. Without doubt, a youthful younger brother must obey the injunctions of his elder brother. Do you, o Kākutstha, accept the installation which I confer on the, precluded by the prescribed religious formulae uttered by Vipras headed by Vasiştha."

sa: स तु द्रोणं समासाद्य व्यूहस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम्। कृताञ्जलिरिदं वाक्यं कृष्णस्यानुमतेऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Approaching Drona who was standing in the mouth of his array, Arjuna, with Krishna's permission, folding his palms thus spoke to Drona.

sa: निवृत्तवनवासोऽसि प्रतिज्ञा पूरिता त्वया। रावणं च रणे हत्वा देवताः परितोषिताः॥
en: The term of your exile is over-your promise has been fulfilled; and slaying Ravana, in the conflict you have pleased the celestials.

sa: तस्मिन् मया हते क्षिप्रमर्जुनं बहवो रथाः। तुल्यरूपा विशिष्टाश्च क्षेप्स्यन्ति भरतर्षम॥
en: He being slain by me, many car-warriors, educed with similar qualities, speedily throw down Arjuna, o bull among the race of Bharata.

sa: एतत् कूजति गाण्डीवं विकृष्टं सव्यसाचिना। एते हस्तवता मुक्ता घ्नन्त्यमित्राशिताः शराः॥
en: This is the twang of the bow Gandiva drawn by Savyasachin. These sharpened arrows discharged off his hands will kill the enemies.

sa: चक्षुष्मन्तं च तं दृष्ट्वा राजानं वपुषान्वितम्। मूर्धा निपतिताः सर्वे विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः॥
en: And seeing the king restored to sight and healthy, they with their eyes expanded in wonder, bowed down their heads to him.

sa: स ददर्श तदाभ्याशे मातरं ते शुभाननाम्। तामपि स्मयमानां स पायसेनाभ्यलेपयम्॥
en: The ascetic at that time saw your beautiful mother standing near. Laughing the while, he sineared her body also with that frumenty.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहव उत्पाता भयशंसिनः। दृश्यन्ते बहवो राजन् हृदयोद्वेगकारकाः॥
en: These and many other omens, fore shadowing fear and danger, were seen, o king and struck the hearts of men with anxiety.

sa: कृतं मया यथा तथ्यं द्विजकार्यमनुत्तमम्। धर्मसेतुमथो भूयः कर्तुमिच्छामि राघवौ॥ अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव धर्मसेतुर्मतो मम। धर्मप्रवचनं चैव सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्॥
en: I have, as promised, performed the work of the excellent twice-born one. I wish now to perform a Rājasūya sacrifice, the source of religious glory, the destroyer of all sins, inexhaustible and un-ending.

sa: ततः प्रादात्पिता कन्यां रुरवे तां प्रमद्वराम्। विवाहं स्थापयित्वाऽग्रे नक्षत्रे भगदैवते॥
en: The Rishi betrothed Pramadvara to Ruru, fixing the day of marriage when the star Bhaga Daivata would be in ascendant. great Rishi

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। शुश्राव वृष्णिचक्रस्य मौसले कदनं कृतम्॥
en: A little while after the Kuru king Yudhishthira heard of the wholesale destruction of the Vrishnis on account of the iron bolt.

sa: यत्र स्म श्रूयते द्रौणिः पुत्रहन्ता महात्मनाम्। स ददर्श महात्मानमुदकान्ते यशस्विनम्॥
en: he saw the great and illustrious and darkcomplexioned and island-born Vyasa sitting near the edge of the water encircled by many Rishis.

sa: ततो रुक्मांगदं चारं विधुन्वानो महारथः। अभ्ययात् सात्यकिस्तूर्णं पुत्रं तव महारथम्॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior Satyaki, having pierced Rukmangada, stretching his bow quickly assailed your son Duryodhana who also was a mighty car-warrior.

sa: वयं तु धृतराष्ट्रेण सपुत्रेण दुरात्मना। विवासिता न दग्धाश्च कथंचिद् दैवसंश्रयात्॥
en: We are banished by the wicked minded Dhritarashtra and his sons and we escaped for our good fortune from a fiery death.

sa: राक्षसा वानराश्चापि न शेकुः स्पन्दितुं भयात्। हनुमांस्तु विवृत्योरस्तस्थौ प्रमुखतो बली॥
en: The Rākşasas and monkeys did not dare stir even out of fear. And the heroic Hanumān, spreading his breast, stood before him.

sa: सांख्यज्ञानं त्वया ब्रह्मन्नवाप्तं कृत्स्नमेव च। तथैव योगशास्त्रं च याज्ञवल्क्य विशेषतः॥
en: O Yajnavalkya, you have acquired the entire science, O Brahmana, of the Sankhyas, as also the scriptures of the Yogins in particular.

sa: राज्ञस्तु याजकस्तत्र कृतो वेदीपरिस्तरः। जुहाव तत्र वह्निं स नृपतिः सत्यसङ्गरः॥
en: The Yajakas had made a sacrificial alter there for the king. Devoted to truth, the latter poured libations then on the fire.

sa: अर्हणं तत्कुमारीणामानृशंस्यतमं च तत्। सर्वं च प्रतिदेयं स्यात् कन्यायै तदशेषतः॥
en: Honour good treatment, and everything else which is agreeable, should all be given to the maiden whose hand is taken in marriage.

sa: मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः स्वस्तिमांश्च गृहान् व्रजेत्॥ दीक्षाकालेषु सर्वेषु यः पठेन्नियतो द्विजः। न्यायवानात्मनिरतः क्षान्तो दान्तोऽनसूयकः॥ रोगार्तो व्याधियुक्तो वा पठन् पापात् प्रमुच्यते। वास्तुमध्ये तु पठतः कुले स्वस्त्ययनं भवेत्॥ क्षेत्रमध्ये तु पठतः सर्वे सस्यं प्ररोहति। गच्छतः क्षेममध्वानं ग्रामान्तरगतः पठन्॥
en: Purged of every sin, such men take birth in auspicious families. That twiceborn person who, with controlled serises, recites these names on ccasions of performing the initiatory rites of sacrifices and other religious practices, becomes as the outcome thereof, gifted with righteousness, devoted to the study of the soul, possessed of forgiveness, and selfcontrol, and free from malice. If a man suffering from disease recites them, he becomes freed from his sin in the form of disease.

sa: क्रौञ्चः कासिकं हृत्वा मृतो जायति मानवः। चोरयित्वा नरः पटें त्वाविकं चैव भारत॥ क्षौमं च वस्त्रमादाय शशो जन्तुः प्रजायते। वर्णान् हृत्वा तु पुरुषो मृतो जायति बर्हिणः॥
en: By stealing a piece of cotton cloth, one becomes a Krauncha bird after renouncing his human body, and O Bharata, stealing a shoulder sheet of cloth, garment made of sheep wool and a piece of linen, one is born as a hare. By stealing different sorts of colouring matter, one is born as a peacock.

sa: न देवतानां काचिद्धि समर्था जातवेदसः। एता हि शक्तास्तं गर्भं संधारयितुमोजसा॥
en: Amongst the celestial ladies there were none, except these, who could by their power, bear the seed of Agni in their wombs.

sa: ततः संचोदयामास व्यासो धर्मात्मजं नृपम्। अश्वमेघ प्रति तदा ततः सोऽन्तर्हितोऽभवत्॥
en: Then Vyasa urged the royal son of Dharma for celebrating the Horse-Sacrifice Having said so, he made himself invisible there and then.

sa: कृच्छ्रेणैव तु तां पार्थो गोविन्दे विनिवेशिताम्। संजहार ततो दृष्टि कृष्णश्चाप्यपराजितः॥
en: With great difficulty, the son of Pritha withdrew his look that had fallen on Govinda. The undefeated Krishna also (did the same).

sa: ततस्तमपरं विप्रं याचे विनिमयेन वै। गवां शतसहस्रं हि तत्कृते गृह्यतामिति॥
en: I then begged the other Brahmana offering him an exchange, and saying-Do you take a hundred thousand kine for this one cow.

sa: अब्रुवश्च महाराज सर्वाः सास्राविलेक्षणाः। स्वस्रीयो वासुदेवस्य मृतो जात इति प्रभो॥
en: All of them, with eyes rendered muddy by tears, repeatedly explained, saying, Alas, the son of Vasudeva's nephew has been born dead.

sa: स हि देवो महातेजाः प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया॥ धर्मार्थं पुरुषव्याघ्र ऋषिकोटी: ससर्ज ह।
en: Gifted with great energy, that god with the desire of benefiting all creatures, created millions of Rishis for the sake of virtue.

sa: अग्नि उवाच शक्रो भृशं सुसुखी पार्थिवेन्द्र प्रीतिं चेच्छत्यजरां वै त्वया सः। देवाश्च सर्वे वशगास्तस्य राजन् संदेशं त्वं शृणु मे देवराज्ञः॥
en: Agni said O king, Shakra is perfectly happy, he is pleased with you, and wishes to make you free from decrepitude, and all the other gods are loyal to him, do you, O king, listen to the message of the King of the Celestials.

sa: तेषु तत्रोपविष्टेषु स तु राजा महामतिः। पाण्डुपुत्रैः परिवृतो निषसाद कुरूद्वह॥
en: After they had all been seated, the Kuru king of great intelligence took his seat there, surrounded by the sons of Pandu.

sa: अग्नि उवाच अहं गच्छामि मघवन् दूतोऽद्य बृहस्पतिं परिदातुं मरुत्ते। वाचं सत्यां पुरुहूतस्य कर्तुं बृहस्पतेश्चापचितिं चिकीर्षुः॥
en: Agni said I shall presently, O worshipful one, go there, as your messenger, to present Brihaspati to king Marutta; and to make Indra's words true, and to show respect to Brihaspati, Agni departed.

sa: तस्य यज्ञः पशुपतेस्तपः क्रतव एव च। दीक्षा दीप्तव्रता देवी दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः॥ देवपत्न्यश्च कन्याश्च देवानां चैव मातरः। आजग्मुः सहितास्तत्र तदा भृगुकुलोद्वह॥
en: Sacrifice, Penance, all the rites, the goddess Diksha burning with rigid observances, the several Points with the presiding deities, the consorts of all the deities, their daughters, and the celestials mothers, all came to Pashupati, O perpetuator of Bhrigu's race, together in a body.

sa: अगाराणीव शून्यानि शान्तार्चिष इवाग्नयः। इन्द्रियाणि न भासन्ते मया होनानि नित्यशः॥
en: It always occurs that without inyself, the senses never shine, like habitations cmpty of inmates or fires whose flames have been quenched.

sa: ततस्तत् परमाश्चर्यं विचित्रं महदद्भुतम्॥ शुश्रुवुस्ते तदा वीराः पितुस्ते जन्म भारत।
en: After this, O Bharata, those heroes heard the news of that highly wonderful and marvellous and glad some birth of your father.

sa: यस्यास्तुश्वशुरो धीमान् बाह्निकः स कुरूद्वहः। निहतः सोमदत्तश्च पित्रा सह महारणे॥
en: Her father-in-law the intelligent Valhika of Kuru's race. Alas, Somadatta also was was killed, along with his father, in the great battle.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्य च तदा दिव्यं चक्षुर्नराधिप। मुनिः सत्यवतीपुत्रः प्रीतः प्रादात् तपोबलात्॥
en: At that time, through the power of his penances, the great ascetic, the of Satyavati, gratified with Dhritarasthra, gave him celestial vision.

sa: द्वादशाहे व्यतीते तु कृतशौचो विशेषतः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो हविर्दत्त्वा मुच्यते तेन पाप्मना॥
en: After the expiration of twelve days, and performing the purification ceremonies duly, the sin is dissipated by giving clarified butter to Brahmanas.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते कुरुजाङ्गलाः। वाष्पसंदिग्धया वाचा रुरुदुर्भरतर्षभ॥
en: Hearing those words of his, all the residents of Kurujangala bewailed aloud, O best of the Bharatas, with voices choked by tears.

sa: अश्वमेधसहस्रेण यो यजेत् पृथिवीपतिः। पालयेद् वापि धर्मेण प्रजास्तुल्यं फलं लभेत्॥
en: That king who worships the celestials in a hundred horse-sacrifices, and he who rules his subjects piously, acquire merit that is equal.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच कुर्यो भूतानि तुष्टोऽहं क्रुद्धो नाशं तथानये। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा न मत्तोऽस्ति वरो द्विजः॥
en: When pleased I am able to create many creatures. When angry, I am able to destroy all. In thought, word, and deed, I am the foremost. The Brahmana is certainly not above me.

sa: कोशेन पौरैर्दण्डेन ये चास्य प्रियकारिणः। असम्भवे तु सर्वस्य यथा मुख्येन निष्पतेत्। क्रमेणानेन मुक्तिः स्याच्छरीरमिति केवलम्॥
en: If the issue of the battle turns against him, he should, then, fall, sacrificing all his resources one after another, renouncing his life in this way, he will acquire freedom from all sorrow.

sa: राजसूयाश्वमेधौ च सर्वमेधं च भारत। नरमेधं च नृपते त्वमाहर युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Do you, O Yudhishthira, prepare for the Rajasuya, and the Horse-Sacrifice, as well as. O Bharata, for the Sarvamedha and the Naramedha.

sa: तत्र कल्पसहस्रं स कन्याभिः सह मोदते॥ सुधारसं च भुञ्जीत अमृतोपममुत्तमम्।
en: He lives in such happiness for a thousand aeons, living with celestial ladies upon ambrosia that is as sweet as nectar itself.

sa: अथ चेदन्यथा कुर्याद् यदि कामाद् युधिष्ठिर। यथा ब्राह्मणचाण्डालः पूर्वदृष्टस्तथैव सः॥
en: If a Brahmana,OYudhishthira, actuated by lust, acts in a different way, he shall come to be considered as a Chandala among Brahmanas.

sa: दानैश्च विविधैः पुण्यैस्तथा तीर्थानुसेवनात्। तपसा महता चैव सुकृतेन च कर्मणा॥
en: You had asked me, O Shakra and I have answered you in full. O destroyer of Asuras, you should never disregard kine!

sa: कन्याकूप उपस्पृश्य बलाकायां कृतोदकः॥ देवेषु लभते कीर्ति यशसा च विराजते॥
en: By bathing in Kanyakupa and performing one's ablutions in Valaka, one wins great fame among even the celestials and shines in glory.

sa: त्रयो गुणाः प्रवर्तन्ते ह्यव्यक्ता नित्यमेव तु। सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव गुणसर्ग: सनातनः॥
en: Indeed, the three qualities always act in an unmanifest form. The creation of those three, viz., Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance is eternal.

sa: ततो यज्ञाः प्रवर्तन्ते हव्यं कव्यं च सर्वशः॥ पयोदधिधृतं चैव पुण्याश्चैताः सुराधिप। वहन्ति विविधान् भारान् क्षुत्तृष्णापरिपीडिताः॥
en: From them originate sacrifices and Havya and Kavya, and milk and curds and clarified butter. Hence, O chief of the celestials, kine are sacred. Stricken with hunger and thirst, they carry various burthens.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो राज्ञाभ्यनुज्ञातो धृतराष्ट्रः प्रतापवान्। ययौ स्वभवनं राजा गान्धार्यानुगतस्तदा।॥
en: Vaishampayana said son Having received the kings' permission, the highly energetic king Dhritarastra, then, went to his own palace, followed by Gandhari.

sa: मातरौ ते तथैवेमे शीर्णपर्णकृताशने। मम तुल्यव्रते पुत्र न चिरं वर्तयिष्यतः॥
en: These two mothers of yours, living now upon fallen leaves of trees, and observing vows similar to mine, will not live long.

sa: अयं हि वृद्धो नृपतिर्हतपुत्रो विशेषतः। नेदं कृच्छ्रे चिरतरं सहेदिति पतिर्मम॥
en: This king is old. He has again, been made sonlcss. I think he will not be able to bear his grief long.

sa: मयाभिपन्ना देवाश्च मोदन्ते शाश्वतीः समाः। इन्द्रो विवस्वान् सोमश्च विष्णुरापोऽग्निरेव च॥
en: The celestials, viz., Indra, Vivasvat, Soma, Vishnu, Varuna, and Agni, having obtained me, are sporting happily and will do so for ever.

sa: आहारं केचिदिच्छन्ति केचिच्चानशने रताः। कर्म केचित् प्रशंसन्ति प्रशान्तिं चापरे जनाः॥
en: Some are for taking food; while some are given to fasts. Some speak highly of action. Others speak highly of perfect tranquility.

sa: परिवादं च ये कुयुर्ब्राह्मणानामचेतसः। सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते राजन् विनश्येयुर्न संशयः॥
en: I tell you truly, O king, that those foolish persons, forsooth, meet with destruction who caluminate the Brahmanas and utter their dispraise.

sa: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च निर्धना ये महाधनाः। कर्मणा केन भगवन् प्राप्नुवन्ति महाफलम्॥
en: By what acts, again, do kings and princes who are immensely rich, and others who are poor, succeed in getting high rewards?

sa: पुरुषस्तद् विजानीते तस्मात् क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते। गुणवृत्तं तथा वृत्तं क्षेत्रज्ञः परिपश्यति॥
en: Purusha knows it; therefore is he called Kshetrajna. The Kshetrajna perceives also the action of the qualities and absence of their actions.

sa: तत्रापि प्रयतो राजन् नहुषस्त्रिदिवे वसन्। मानुषीश्चैव दिव्याश्च कुर्वाणो विविधाः क्रियाः॥
en: With controlled senses, O king, he lived in the celestial region, engaged in doing diverse acts of both human an celestial nature.

sa: इत्येतत् क्षत्रबन्धूनां वदन्ति परमां श्रियम्। पुनाति दत्ता पृथिवी दातारमिति शुश्रुम॥
en: This is the highest source of prosperity to Kshatriyas. We have heard that earth, when given away, cleanses and sanctifies the giver.

sa: पञ्चानामशनं दत्त्वा शेषमश्नन्ति साधवः। न जल्पन्ति च भुजाना न निद्रान्त्याईपाणयः॥
en: After feeding the five they take their own food. They never talk while eating, and never go to sleep with wet hands.

sa: एतेनैवानुमानेन मन्यन्ते वै मनीषिणः। सत्त्वं च पुरुषश्चैव तत्र नास्ति विचारणा॥
en: It is by this inference that the wise believe in the oneness of Purusha and Goodness. There is no doubt in this.

sa: यथा चन्द्रमसो वृद्धिरहन्यहनि जायते। तथा भूमिकृतं दानं सस्ये सस्ये विवर्धते॥
en: As the moon increases day by day, so the merit of a gift of earth increases every time such earth produces crops.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं वै स विपन्नश्च कथं वै पातितो भुवि। कथं चानिन्द्रतां प्राप्तस्तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Yudhishthira said How was Nahusha plunged into distress? How was he hurled down on the Earth? How, indeed, was he deprived of the sovereignty of the celestials? You should recite everything to me.

sa: ततो यज्ञ समाप्तौ तान् विससर्ज महामुनीन्। अगस्त्यः परमप्रीतः पूजयित्वा यथाविधि॥
en: On the termination of that sacrifice, Agastya, filled with joy, adored all those great Rishis duly and then sent them all away.

sa: कार्तिकं तु नरो मासं यः कुर्यादेकभोजनम्। शूरश्च बहुभार्यश्च कीर्तिमांश्चैव जायते॥
en: He who passes the month of Kartika, taking himself one meal every day, becomes possessed of heroism, many wives and great fame.

sa: ऋषिमङ्गिरसं पूर्वं पृष्टवानस्मि भारत। यथा मां त्वं तथैवाहं पृष्टवांस्तं तपोधनम्॥
en: I had, O Bharata, asked the Rishi Angirasa of great ascetic merit, the very same questions which you have asked me today.

sa: सायं प्रातश्च सततं होमकाले महायुते। गावो ददति वै होम्यमृषिभ्यः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Morning and evening kine give to the Rishis, O foremost of men, Havi for use in Homa, O you of great effulgence.

sa: द्वादशेऽहनि तेभ्यः स कृतशौचो नराधिपः। ददौ श्राद्धानि विधिवद् दक्षिणावन्ति पाण्डवः॥
en: On the twelfth day, the king, properly purified, duly performed the Shraddhas of his deceased relations, which were marked by profuse gifts.

sa: यदत्रानन्तरं कार्य तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति। इत्युक्तः संजयेनेदं पुनराह स पार्थिवः॥ नैष मृत्युरनिष्टो नो निःसृतानां गृहात् स्वयम्। जलमग्निस्तथा वायुरथवाऽपि विकर्षणम्॥ तापसानां प्रशस्यन्ते गच्छ संजय मा चिरम्। इत्युक्त्वा संजयं राजा समाधाय मनस्तथा॥
en: That which should next be done should be marked by you. Thus addressed by Sanjaya the king once more said, “This death cannot be calamitous to us, for we have left our home of own accord. Water, fire, wind, and abstention from food, are laudable for ascetics. Do you, therefore, leave us, O Sanjaya, forthwith.' Having said these words to Sanjaya the king concentrated his mind.

sa: विप्रकारान् प्रयुक्ते स्म सुबहून् मम वेश्मनि। तानुदारतया चाहं चक्षमे चातिदुःसहान्॥
en: While living in my house he committed various mischief's. Thought difficult of being borne. I suffered them yet from magnanimity of heart.

sa: तत ऊचुर्महात्मानो देवाः सर्वे समागताः। रुद्र रौद्रा भविष्यन्ति पशवः सर्वकर्मसु॥
en: The highsouled celestials in a body addressed him, saying, O Rudra, the Asuras threaten to display their destructive influence in all deeds.

sa: यत्रेच्छागामिनो दान्ताः सर्वशत्रुनिषूदनाः। प्रार्थयन्ति च यद् दान्ता लभन्ते तन्न संशयः॥
en: The self-controlled can go everywhere at will. The self-controlled can destroy every enemy. Forsooth, the self-controlled succeed in getting everything they seek.

sa: जलौकसां स सत्त्वानां बभूव प्रियदर्शनः। उपाजिघ्रन्त च तदा तस्योष्ठं हृष्टमानसाः॥
en: He became quite agreeable to all creatures living in water. Without the least fear, all these used to smell the Rishi's lips.

sa: एवमुक्ते ततो वाक्ये च्यवनो भार्गवस्तदा। कुशिकं प्रत्युवाचेदं मुदा परमया युतः॥
en: Addressed in these words by the king, Chyavana of Bhrigu's race, filled with great joy, said to Kushika these words in reply.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथासनमुपादाय च्यवनस्य महामुनेः। कुशिको भार्यया सार्धमाजगाम यतो मुनिः॥
en: Bhishma said Ordering a seat to be placed for the great ascetic Chyavana, king Kushika, accompanied by his wife, stood before him.

sa: तेषामन्तर्गतं ज्ञात्वा देवानां स पितामहः॥ मानवानां प्रमोहार्थे कृत्या नार्योऽसृजत् प्रभुः।
en: Having learnt what was in the hearts of the celestials, the powerful Grandfather created women with the help of an Atharvan rite.

sa: स जगाम ततः शीघ्रमुत्तङ्कणे ब्राह्मणर्षभः। सौदास पुरुषादं वै भिक्षितुं मणिकुण्डले॥
en: That foremost of Brahmanas, Utanka, proceeded forthwith to Saudasa who had become a cannibal, in order to solicit the earrings from him.

sa: स तथेति प्रतिश्रुत्य जगाम जनमेजय। गुरुपत्नीप्रियार्थं वै ते समानयितुं तदा॥
en: Replying her, 'So be it'. Utanka went away. O Janamejaya, determined upon bringing those ear-rings for doing what his preceptor's wife liked.

sa: निरता येन भावेन तत्र मे शृणु कारणम्। सम्यक् चायमनुप्रश्नस्त्वयोक्तस्तु युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Listen to me as I explain the reason to you. The question you have put to me is indeed, excellent, O Yudhishthira!

sa: शरीरे जायते व्याधिः शारीरः स निगद्यते। मानसे जायते व्याधिर्मानसस्तु निगद्यते॥
en: The disease that is produced in the body, is called physical, and that which is produced in the mind, is called mental.

sa: अध्यारोहन्त शतशः सुवेलं यत्र राघवः। ते त्वदीर्पण कालेन गिरिमारुह्य सर्वतः।।।।
en: And all those rangers of mountains, gifted with the vehemence of the Wind in hundreds ascended mount Suvela, where Rāghava was stationed.

sa: अचिन्त्यामद्भुताकारां दृष्ट्वा लङ्कां महाकपिः। आसीद् विषण्णो दृष्टश्च वैदेह्या दर्शनोत्सुकः। ५२।।
en: Beholding Lankā, wonderful and of inconceivable loveliness, the mighty monkey, desirous of beholding Vaidehī, became depressed and delighted at the same time.

sa: शुश्राव जपतां तत्र मन्त्रान् रक्षोगृहेषु वै। स्वाध्यायनिरतांश्चैव यातुधानान् ददर्श सः॥
en: And (Hanumān) heard there in the mansions of the Rākṣas, Mantras recited by persons engaged therein, and those occupied in Vaidika studies.

sa: ननन्द दृष्ट्वा स च तान् सुरूपान् नानागुणानात्मगुणानुरूपान्। विद्योतमानान् स च तान् सुरूपान् ददर्श कांश्चिच्च पुनर्विरूपान्॥
en: And beholding those well-formed people, whose conduct was of a piece with their many virtues, (Hanumān) rejoiced exceedingly. And he saw some having beautiful forms, and others deformed, and both possessed of splendour.

sa: शुशुभे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स्वपतः शयनं शुभम्। गन्धहस्तिनि संविष्टे यता प्रस्रवणं महत्॥
en: As the sovereign of the Rākșasas was sleeping, his graceful bed resembled a grand cascade, beside which stands an elephant breathing odour.

sa: तासामुच्छ्वासवातेनं वस्त्रं माल्यं च गात्रजम्। नात्यर्थं स्पन्दते चित्रं प्राप्य मन्मिवानिलम्॥
en: And with their breath, their variegated wreaths and the cloth on their persons were stirring gently, as if with a mild-blowing breeze.

sa: तथैव त्वां समासाद्य लङ्का रत्नौघसंकुला। अपराधात् तवैकस्य न चिराद् विनशिष्यति॥
en: Obtaining you, (therefore) as her king and for your folly only, this city of Lankā, abounding in jewels, shall soon be ruined.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु राक्षस्या समुत्क्षिप्तस्ततो बली। प्रहसन् मेघसंकाशो राक्षसः स न्यवर्तत ॥
en: Having said this, the Rākşasī took away Rāvana by force. And that Rākşasa too, resembling a mass of clouds, laughing, turned back.

sa: यादृशानि तु दृश्यन्ते लङ्कायामशुभानि तु। अचिरेणैव कालेन भविष्यति हतप्रभा ॥
en: Besides from these bad omens, that are to be seen here, it appear, that Lankä shall soon be shorn of her grace.

sa: नूनं ममैव शोकेन स वीरो लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। देवलोकमितो यातस्त्यक्त्वा देहं महीतले॥
en: Or renouncing his body on this earth for my grief, the heroic elder brother of Lakşmaņa, has repaired to the celestial region.

sa: गते हि मयि तत्रेयं राजपुत्री यशश्विनी। परित्राणमपश्यन्ती जानकी जीवितं त्यजेत्॥
en: And if I go away, the royal daughter, the famed Janaki, finding no means of safety, shall, for certain, renounce her life.

sa: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हनूमान् हरिपुङ्गवः। दुःखाद् दुःखाभिभूतायाः सान्त्वमुत्तरमब्रवीत्॥ अहं रामस्य संदेशाद् देवि दूतस्तवागतः। वैदेहि कुशली रामः स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत् ॥
en: Hearing those words of Sītā stricken with grief, Hanumān, the foremost of the monkeys, replied in soothing words, O worshipful lady, by Rāma's decree I come as a messenger to these. He is sale and sound, O Vaidehi, and has asked of your welfare.

sa: सागराविव संक्षुब्धौ चलमूलाविवाचलौ। तेजोयुक्ताविवादित्यौ प्रदहन्ताविवानलौ ॥ बलोद्धतौ यथा नागौ वासितार्थे यथा वृषौ। मेघाविव विनर्दन्तौ सिंहाविव बलोत्कटौ॥ रुद्रकालाविव क्रुद्धौ तौ तदा राक्षसार्जुनौ। परस्परं गदां गृह्य ताडयामासतुर्भृशम्॥
en: And taking up their clubs Arjuna and Råvaņa began to fight with one another emitting cries like the mutterings of clouds, like to two huge balls fighting for a cow, two agitated oceans, two moving mountains, two effulgent Adityas, two burning flames, two proud elephants, two proud lions and like the very Rudra and Kāla.

sa: श्रुत्वैव च वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः। चमूं प्रकर्षन् महतीं हर्यक्षगणसंकुलाम्॥
en: No sooner shall Rāghava hear from me than he shall speedily repair hither followed by a huge army of monkeys and bears.

sa: भर्तुर्भक्तिं पुरस्कृत्य रामादन्यस्य वानर। नाहं स्पष्टुं स्वतो गात्रमिच्छेयं वानरोत्तम ॥
en: O monkey, being guided by my love for my husband, I do not like willingly to touch any body's person but Rāma's.

sa: स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम्। वर्धार्हमपि काकुत्स्थः कृपया पर्यपालयत्॥
en: And, placing himself on the earth, he sought his shelter, and Kākutstha, out of mercy, saved him, albeit worthy of being killed.

sa: स तं मणिवरं गृह्य श्रीमान् प्लवगसत्तमः॥ प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं गमनायोपचक्रमे।
en: Thereupon, taking that best of gems, that graceful foremost of monkeys, bowing down the head to that exalted one, prepared to depart.

sa: त्वया विज्ञातपूर्वश्च वाली वानरपुङ्गव। स तेन निहतः संख्ये शरेणैकेन वानरः॥
en: You formerly has known that foremost of monkeys, Vāli. That monkey was slain in battle by him (Rāma) with a single shaft.

sa: यां सीतेत्यभिजानासि येयं तिष्ठति ते गृहे। कालरात्रीति तां विद्धि सर्वलङ्काविनाशिनीम्॥
en: Her-whom you know as Sītā staying in yours abode-know her for the Fatal Night that shall bring destruction down on all Lankā.

sa: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा अहमप्यब्रुवं वचः॥ देवि रामस्य भर्तुस्ते सहायो भीमविक्रमः। सुग्रीवो नाम विक्रान्तो वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः॥
en: Hearing her speech, I too said, O revered one, your husband, Rāma, has found a helpmate in a one endowed with terrific strength, named Sugrīva— redoubtable, the highly powerful lord of the monkeys.

sa: दूतवध्या न दृष्टा हि राजशास्त्रेषु राक्षस। दूतेन वेदितव्यं च यथाभिहितवादिना॥
en: The destruction of an envoy is not sanctioned by the royal morality, O Raksasa. They communicate simply the mandate of their masters.

sa: जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् सर्वाननुज्ञाप्य महाकपीन्। अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये भवतां च निवेदिते। न्याय्यं स्म सह वैदेह्या द्रष्टुं तौ पार्थिवात्मजौ॥
en: I have related to you what had happened. It now behove us to behold Vaidehi along with those two sons of a king, after commanding all the monkeys headed by Jambavan and others.

sa: यद् रक्षति महावीरः सदा दधिमुखः कपिः। मातुलः कपिमुख्यस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The monkey-chief Sugrīva's maternal uncle, the heroic and high-souled Dadhimukha always guard that picturesque and spacious garden of the lord of monkeys.

sa: पूजयित्वाङ्गदं सर्वे वानरा वानरर्षभम् ॥ जग्मुर्मधुवनं यत्र नदीवेग इव दुमम्।
en: saw And adoring Angada-their prince, those monkeys proceeded by the way leading to the Madhuvana like to trees carried by a stream.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहो कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः। वायसे त्वं व्यधाः क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वरः॥
en: Thereupon, your eyes rolling with ire, you, O mighty armed hero, O foremost of the intelligent, did resolve to destroy that crow.

sa: निम्नेषु वनदुर्गेषु वनेषु च वनौकसः। अभिप्लुत्याभिपश्येयुः परेषां निहितं बलम् ॥
en: And, bounding down into hollow places, mountain-fastnesses, and woods, let the rangers of the wilds, spy the posted detachments of the enemy.

sa: यत्तु फल्गु बलं किंचित्तदत्रैवोपपद्यताम्। एतद्धि कृत्यं घोरं नो विक्रमेण प्रयुज्यताम्॥
en: Let those that are incompetent, stay here. This business is dreadful, and we should apply our best strength in conducting the same.

sa: हृतामवाप्य वैदेहीं क्षिप्रं हत्वा च रावणम्॥ समृद्धार्थः समृद्धार्थामयोध्यां प्रतियास्यसि। महान्ति च निमित्तानि दिवि भूमौ च राघव॥ शुभानि तव पश्यामि सर्वाण्येवार्थसिद्धये।
en: Speedily recovering Vaidehi, who has been carried away, and slaying Rāvana, you will, your end attained, return to Ayodhyā, who shall also have her desire. O Rāghava, I see all the great auspicious omens on earth and in the sky, signifying success to you.

sa: निविष्टायां तु सेनायां तीरे नदनदीपतेः। पार्श्वस्थं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा रामो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The army being encamped on the shore of the lord of streams and rivers, Rāma, beholding Laksmana by his side, spoke, saying.

sa: कदा नु खलु मे साध्वी सीतामरसुतोपमा। सोत्कण्ठा कण्ठमालम्ब्य मोक्ष्यत्यानन्दजं जलम्॥
en: When shall my devoted Sītā resembling the daughter of a celestial, fling herself anxiously around my neck and shed tears of joy?

sa: निर्जितास्ते महाबाहो नागा गत्वा रसातलम्। वासुकिस्तक्षकः शङ्खो जटी च वशमाहृताः॥
en: And entering the region under the earth, you did defeat the serpents-and thus bring under your subjection Väsuki, Takşaka, Sankha, and Jațī.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं रामं संरब्धो वाहिनीपतिः। वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकुशलं ततो मौनमुपागमत्॥
en: Having thus accosted Rāma, skilled in the are of speech, that lord of the army, Sugriva, well versed in speech, became silent.

sa: अमात्या राक्षसेन्द्रस्य चक्रुरायोधनं महत्। अन्योन्यं ते महाभागा जघ्नुः प्रहरणै शम्॥
en: And those councillors of the lord of Räkşasas, assailed with every kind of weapons, with their persons bathed in blood, fought fiercely.

sa: अथ रामः प्रसन्नात्मा श्रुत्वा वायुसुतस्य ह। प्रत्यभाषत दुर्धर्षः श्रुतवानात्मनि स्थितम्॥
en: Hearing those words of the Wind-god's son, the irrepressible Rāma, conversant with all the Šāstras, replied, with words expressing his own opinion.

sa: स दुष्टो वाप्यदुष्टो वा किमेष रजनीचरः। ईदृशं व्यसनं प्राप्तं भ्रातरं यः परित्यजेत् ॥ को नाम स भवेत्तस्य यमेष न परित्यजेत्।
en: Whether this ranger of the night is sincere or wicked, he should never be offered any shelter, since he has forsaken his brother in the midst of these calamities. What reason is there to believe that he shall not renounce us in our difficulty?

sa: शार्दूलस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। उवाच सहसा व्यग्रः संप्रधार्यार्थमात्मनः। शुकं साधु तदा रक्षो वाक्यमर्थविदां वरम्।।।।।
en: Hearing the words of Sardāla, Ravana, the lord of Rākşasas, being anxious to ascertain his duty, addressed a Raksasa by name Suka, the most sensible of his counsellors, with the following pregnant words.

sa: शुकस्य वचनं रामः श्रुत्वा तु परिदेवितम्। उवाच मावधिष्टेति घ्नतः शाखामृगर्षभान्॥१९
en: Hearing the piteous accents of Suka, Rama spoke to the monkeys, who were about to kill him, saying, Do not kill him.

sa: परिगृह्योदकं शीतं वनानि फलवन्ति च। बलौघं संविभज्येमं व्यूह्य तिष्ठेम लक्ष्मण॥
en: O Laksmana, occupying (this tract) of cool waters and woods affluent with fruits, will we, dividing and arranging our forces, stay here.

sa: शिखरैर्विकिरामैनां लङ्कां मुष्टिभिरेव वा। इति स्म दधिरे सर्वे मनांसि हरिपुङ्गवाः॥
en: We shall demolish Lankā by hurling mountain-peaks, or with our clenched fists. Thus did the foremost of monkeys think in their minds.

sa: उद्विग्ना शङ्किता चास्मि न स्वस्थं च मनोगम। तद्भयाच्चाहमुद्विग्ना अशोकवनिकां गता॥
en: And I am agitated and alarmed and my mind is (always) uneasy. And I, dwelling in the Asoka wood, is ever agitated.

sa: स संभ्रान्तश्च निष्क्रान्तो यत्कृते राक्षसेश्वरः। तत्र मे विदितं सर्वमभिनिष्क्रम्य मैथिलि।७।।
en: And, O Maithili, I, coming out, have also learnt well as to why the lord of Rākṣasas has gone out hence hurriedly.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः। दृष्ट्वा तत्तुमुलं युद्धं परं विस्मयमागमन्॥
en: And then the celestials and the Gandharvas and the sages studying the Vedas, beholding the great encounter, were filled with mighty amazement.

sa: सभाजिता त्वां रामेण मोदिष्यसि महात्मना। सुवर्षेण समायुक्ता यथा सस्येन मेदिनी॥
en: And, loved by the high-souled Rama, you, shall be happy, even as the Earth furnished with crops brought forth by plenteous showers.

sa: व्याला गोमायवो गृध्रा वाश्यन्ति च सुभैरवम्। प्रविश्य लङ्कामारामे समवायाश्च कुर्वते॥
en: And beasts of prey, jackals and vultures, are emitting frightful cries, and, entering into the garden of Lankā, form themselves into bands.

sa: कालिकाः पाण्डुरैर्दन्तैः प्रहसन्त्यग्रतः स्थिताः। स्त्रियः स्वप्नेषु मुष्णन्त्यो गृहाणि प्रतिभाष्य च।।२८
en: In dreams mighty dark-hued women in front of dwellings, seizing at (the furniture) thereof, and speaking inauspiciously, laugh displaying their sable teeth.

sa: संविधानं यथाहुस्ते रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। राम तब्रुवतः सर्वं याथातथ्येन मे शृणु॥
en: O Rāma, hearken to me as I tell you truly anent the provisions which they have related, made by the wicked-minded Ravana.

sa: श्रूयतां सर्वमाख्यास्ये यथावृत्तमिदं तव। हेमा नामाप्सरास्तत्र श्रुतपूर्वा यदि त्वया ॥ दैवतैर्मम सा दत्ता पौलोमीव शतक्रतोः। तस्यां भक्तमना ह्यासं दशवर्षशतान्यहम्॥ सा च दैवतकार्येण त्रयोदश समा गताः। वर्ष चतुर्दशं चैव ततो हेममयं पुरम्॥ वज्रवैदूर्यचित्रं च मायया निर्मितं मया। तत्राहमवसं दीनस्तया हीनः सुदुःखितः।।।।
en: 'Listen. I shall tell you all about this. You may ere this have heard of an Apsarā named Hemā. She like to the Paulomi of Satakratu was bestowed on me, by the gods. And I passed a thousand years, being devoted her. Thirteen years have passed away since she had gone on a business of the celestials, as also the fourteenth year. Then I through my extraordinary skill constructed a golden palace, adorned with diamond and lapises. There I dwelt, aggrieved and sorrowful on account of her separation.

sa: प्रायेण गतसत्वानां पुरुषाणां गतायुषाम्। दृश्यमानेषु वक्रेषु परं भवति वैकृतम्॥ त्यज शोकं च दुःखं च मोहं च जनकात्मजे। रामलक्ष्मणयोरर्थे नाद्य शक्यमजीवितुम्॥
en: It generally happens that the faces of persons dead and gone, are unsightly to a degree. Therefore, O Janka's daughter, leave off grief and sorrow and stupor. For the sake of Rāma and Lakşmaņa you can not today put a period to your existence.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा ब्रह्मा दशग्रीवमुवाच ह। नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं ते वरमन्यं वृणीष्व मे॥
en: Thus accosted, Brahma spoke to the Tennecked one, 'You can not be immortal. Do you therefore ask of me some other boon.'

sa: अथ वर्षसहस्त्रे तु दशमे दशमं शिरः। छेत्तुकामे दशग्रीवे प्राप्तस्तत्र पितामहः॥
en: And as in the tenth year he intended to strike off his tenth head, the Great-father (Brahmā) presented himself at that place.

sa: अहं तु रावणं हत्वा सपुत्रं सहबान्धवम्। मैथिलीमानयिष्यामि शक्रो नष्टामिव श्रियम्॥
en: And I, slaying Råvaņa along with his sons and friends, shall bring back Mithila's daughter, even as Sakra recovered the lost Sri.

sa: धूम्राक्षेणार्दितं सैन्यं व्यथितं प्रेक्ष्य मारुतिः। अभ्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शिलाम्॥
en: Seeing the forces hard beset by Dhūmrākşa and distressed thereat, the Windgod's offspring, waxing enraged, seizing a huge crag, approached (the Rākşasa).

sa: ईदृशास्ते भविष्यन्ति पुत्राः पुत्रि न संशयः। तेजसा भास्करसमो यादृशोऽयं धनेश्वरः॥
en: Then, O daughter, even as this lord of riches, so you will, without doubt, have sons resembling the Sun himself in energy.

sa: स विस्फारितसर्वाङ्गो गिरिशृङ्गेण ताडितः॥ पपात सहसा भूमौ विकीर्ण इव पर्वतः।
en: On being assailed with the mountain-peak, Dhūmrākşa, having his entire body mangled, suddenly fell to the earth, like to a toppling hill.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सह राक्षसैः। अवध्यत्वं त्वया प्राप्तं वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम्। ५४।।
en: Incapable of being slain by gods, Dānavas or Gandharvas, Yaksas or Raksasas, Fear has (at last), found you, coming even from monkeys.

sa: ततो रामो महातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्। किरीटिनं महाकायं कुम्भकर्णं ददर्श ह॥
en: Then the exceedingly energetic Rāma possessed of prowess, taking his bow, saw Kumbhakarņa, having a huge body and decked with a diadem.

sa: ये तु पूर्व महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णेन पातिताः। ते स्वस्था वानरश्रेष्ठाः सुग्रीवमुपतस्थिरे॥
en: Those high-souled and powerful monkeys that formerly had been brought down by Kumbhakarma, having recovered, were present with Sugrīva in this encounter.

sa: ततस्तु वानराः सर्वे भिन्नदेहा विचेतसः। व्यथिता विद्रवन्ति स्म रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः॥
en: All the monkeys, with their bodies riven and deprived of their senses, and bathed in blood and writhing in torments, pursued (Indrajit).

sa: विशल्यौ च महात्मानौ तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। असंभ्रान्तौ जगृहतुस्ते उभे धनुषी वरे॥
en: On those high-souled ones both Rāma and Lakşmaņa-having been cured of their wounds, possessing themselves in calmness, took up their excellent bows.

sa: तस्यास्तु शीलवृत्ताभ्यां तुतोष मुनिपुङ्गवः। प्रीतः स तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: And that best of ascetics was gratified with her character and behaviour. And well pleased (with her), that highly energetic one said.

sa: तत्र ताराधिपस्याभा ताराणां भा तथैव च। तयोराभरणाभा च ज्वलिता द्यामभासयत्॥
en: There the light of the moon and that of the stars and the brilliance of their omaments, combined, lighted up the welkin.

sa: स रामं सूर्यसंकाशैः शरैर्दत्तवरै शम्। विव्याध समरे क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु रावणिः॥
en: In that encounter, Rāvana's son, inflamed with ire, wounded Rāma, with shafts, resembling the Sun and obtained by him as a boon.

sa: इन्द्रजित्तु रथे स्थाप्य सीतां मायामयीं तदा। बलेन महतावृत्य तस्या वधमरोचयत्॥
en: Placing an illusory figure of Sītā on the car, encircled by a huge army he began to make arrangements for her destruction.

sa: इममर्थ हि विज्ञाप्य रामं सुग्रीवमेव च। तौ यत्प्रतिविधास्येते तत्करिष्यामहे वयम्॥
en: Let us now go and inform Rāma and Sugrīva of it. And we shall do as we shall be commanded by them.

sa: तं भूमौ देवसंकाशं पतितं दृश्य राघवम्। अभिपेतुः समुत्पत्य सर्वतः कपिसत्तमाः॥
en: Seeing the god-like Råghava down on the earth, the foremost monkeys from all sides rushed forward and came to where (he was).

sa: वानरान्मोहयित्वा तु प्रतियातः स राक्षसः। मायामयीं महाबाहो तां विद्धि जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: Having bewildered the monkeys, the Raksasa has gone back; and, O mighty-armed one, know her to be the illusory daughter of Janaka.

sa: ततः संचोदमानो वै हरीरक्षोवधप्रियान्। उवाच वचनं काले कालज्ञो रक्षसां वरः॥
en: Then inciting the monkeys, whose dear object was to slay Ravana, that one versed in time, the foremost of Rākşasas,spoke seasonably thus.

sa: तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं दृष्ट्वा तं भ्रातृवत्सलम्। मुमुचुनिरा बाष्पं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः॥
en: Hearing Bharata speak in that wise and beholding him devoted to his brother all the monkeys and the Rākşasa Vibhîşana shed tears.

sa: विभीषणं च भरतः सान्त्ववाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। दिष्ट्या त्वया सहायेन कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Bharata then addressed Vibhiṣaṇa with soothing words, “It is by fortune that through your help he has accomplished such a difficult work."

sa: मायया मम वत्सेन वञ्चनार्थ वनौकसाम्। किंचिदेव हतं तत्र सीतेयमिति दर्शितम्॥
en: By his power of illusion, my beloved child, for deceiving the wood-rangers, slaying something (else), had shown it to them as Sītā.

sa: भ्राता तु गृध्रराजस्य संपातिर्नाम वीर्यवान्। समाख्याति स्म वसती सीतां रावणमन्दिरे।॥
en: The powerful brother of the king of vultures named Sampāti communicated to us the residence of Sītā in the palace of Rāvaņa.

sa: वैदेही प्रार्थयानं तं विराधं प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसम्। हतमेकेन रामेण पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: Beholding the Rākşasa Virādha slain by Rāma alone (Rāvana) wishing Vaidehỉ should have regarded that as a sufficient proof of his prowess.

sa: ततो नष्टप्रभः सूर्यो दिशश्च तिमिरावृताः। द्विजाश्च नेदुर्घोराश्च संचचाल च मेदिनी॥
en: Thereat the sun lost its brilliance the quarters were enshrouded with darkness; the birds sent forth dreadful cried and the earth shook.

sa: उवाच च समीपस्थं महोदरमनन्तरम्। अस्मिन्काले महाबाहो जयाशा त्वयि मे स्थिता।।४
en: He addressed Mahodara who was near him saying, you of great arms, all my hopes of success are now centred in you.

sa: स नीलमिव जीमूतं तोयपूर्ण नभस्तलात्। उत्पपात गृहीत्वा तु हनूमाशिखरं गिरेः॥
en: And taking that summit of the mountain resembling dark-blue clouds charged with rain, Hanumān from the earth bounded up in the sky.

sa: अहं तु वधमिच्छामि शीघ्रमस्य दुरात्मनः। यावदस्तं न यात्येष कृतकर्मा दिवाकरः॥
en: I wish the speedy destruction of this impious one, ere the maker of day, having performed his work, has ascended the Setting-hill.

sa: अहं तु वधमिच्छामि शीघ्रमस्य दुरात्मनः। यावदस्तं न यात्येष कृतकर्मा दिवाकरः॥
en: I wish the speedy destruction of this impious one, ere the maker of day, having performed his work, has ascended the Setting-hill.

sa: ततः प्रीतमना रामः श्रुत्वैवं वदतां वरः। दध्यौ मुहूर्त धर्मात्मा हर्षव्याकुललोचनः॥
en: Thereupon hearing those words-the virtuoussouled Rāma, the foremost of those skilled in speech, with his eyes agitated with delight, meditated for sometime.

sa: तमुवाच ततो धीमान्विभीषण इदं वचः॥ विमृश्य बुद्ध्या प्रश्रितं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्।
en: Where to the intelligent Vibhīşaņa replied with the following words-pointing out wealth and Piety, and judging by his understanding what is proper.

sa: अप्रीतेन गुणैर्भा त्यक्ताया जनसंसदि। या क्षमा मे गतिर्गन्तुं प्रवेक्ष्ये हव्यवाहनम्॥
en: To adopt the proper course for me who had been renounced before this assembly by my disaffected husband I shall enter this.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु सप्तत्या सात्यकिर्नवभिः शरैः॥ धर्मराजस्तथा षष्ट्या गात्रे शल्यं समार्पयत्। ।
en: Then Bhimasena pierced the king of the Madras with seventy arrows and Satyaki pierced him with nine and king Yudhishthira with sixty.

sa: आस्थाय तु रथं शुभ्रं युक्तमश्वैर्मनोजवैः। अन्वयात् पृष्ठतो राजन् युयुत्सुः पाण्डवाग्रजम्॥
en: Riding upon another white car to which were yoked horses fleet as thought, Yuyutsu, O king, followed the eldest son of Pandu.

sa: समस्तं प्रतिजग्राह पृष्ट्वा गोत्रादि सर्वशः। उष्यतां स्वागतं चेति प्रीतिमांश्चाभवद् भृशम्॥
en: With this knowledge about his birth and family, Rama received him kindly and said, You are welcome!-at which Karna became highly pleased.

sa: क्रियाभ्युपायैरिन्द्रेण त्रिदिव भुज्यते विभो॥ क्रिया बलवती राजन् नान्यत् किंचिद् युधिष्ठिर।
en: Indra himself enjoys heaven by the power of illusion. Action is very efficacious O king and nothing else is so, O Yudhishthira.

sa: अन्यां चापहृतं कायाचारुकुण्डलमुन्नसम्। स्वस्य बन्धोः शिरः कृष्ण गृहीत्वा पश्य तिष्ठतीम्॥१०
en: See, O Krishna, taking up some relative's severed head adorned with beautiful nose and ear-rings, some one amongst them, is standing sorrowfully.

sa: तमूर्ध्वबाहुं निश्चेष्टं दृष्ट्वा हविरुपस्थितम्। अब्रवीद् भगवान् साक्षान्महादेवो हसन्निव॥ सत्यशौचार्जवत्यागैस्तपसा नियमेन च। क्षान्त्या भक्त्या च बुद्ध्या च वचसा तथा॥ यथावदहमाराद्धः कृष्णेनाक्लिकर्मणा। तस्मादिष्टतमः कृष्णादन्यो मम न विद्यते॥
en: Seeing him stand fixed and with uplifted hands and as an offering to himself, the divine Mahadeva appeared personally and smilingly said'With truth, purity, sincerity, resignation, ascetic practices, vows, forgiveness, devotion, patience, thought and word, I have been duly worshipped by Krishna of pure deeds. For this there is none dearer to me than Krishna.

sa: वध्यन्ते न ह्यविश्वस्ताः शत्रुभिर्दुर्बला अपि॥ वि तास्तेषु वध्यन्ते बलवन्तोऽपि दुर्बलैः।
en: However weak people may be, if they mistrust their enemies, the latter, even if strong, never succeed in reigning supreme over them.
